docstring: Claim 6.17 for the literal Algorithm 8 implementation.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.claim_6_17_algorithmEight_rank
type:
∀ (setGen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ)
  (hinfinite : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator setGen) (family : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (selection : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → ℕ) → Finset ℕ) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetCoreSelectionInvariant setGen family selection →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = family i) →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankFallback.InheritsAmbientOrder (orders i)) →
          ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
            (∃ N, ∀ (t : ℕ), N ≤ t → target ∈ selection t fun i => stream ↑i) →
              (∃ N,
                  ∀ (t : ℕ),
                    N ≤ t →
                      ρ ≤ (orders target).lowerDensity (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setOutput setGen stream t)) →
                ∃ N,
                  ∀ (t : ℕ),
                    N ≤ t →
                      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.canonicalRank (orders target) (orders target).carrier
                          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementOutputStream
                            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightGenerator setGen hinfinite selection orders ρ)
                            stream t) ≤
                        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightRankCutoff ρ
                          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightIndexOn setGen selection orders ρ stream t) t

                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightRankCutoff ρ (stage t) t) →
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.AsymptoticDisplacementAtMost K output (2 / ρ)

docstring:

the quantitative Algorithm 8 construction above.  Otherwise the requested
density lower bound is nonpositive, so any positive Algorithm 8 budget gives
generation and ordered-density nonnegativity closes the bound.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.corollary_6_16
type:
∀ (setGen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator setGen →
    ∀ (family : ℕ → Set ℕ) (selection : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → ℕ) → Finset ℕ)
      (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (ρ ε : ℝ),
      0 < ε →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetCoreSelectionInvariant setGen family selection →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = family i) →
            (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankFallback.InheritsAmbientOrder (orders i)) →
              ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
                (∃ N, ∀ (t : ℕ), N ≤ t → target ∈ selection t fun i => stream ↑i) →
                  ρ ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedLowerDensity setGen (orders target) stream →
                    ∃ gen,
                      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn gen (family target) stream ∧
                        (ρ - ε) / 2 ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementBasedLowerDensity gen (orders target) stream

docstring:

`liminf` guarantee supplies the eventual pointwise premise of Theorem 6.15.

type:
∀ (setGen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ)
  (hinfinite : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator setGen) (family : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (selection : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → ℕ) → Finset ℕ) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (ρ ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    0 < ρ - ε →
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetCoreSelectionInvariant setGen family selection →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = family i) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankFallback.InheritsAmbientOrder (orders i)) →
            ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
              (∃ N, ∀ (t : ℕ), N ≤ t → target ∈ selection t fun i => stream ↑i) →
                ρ ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedLowerDensity setGen (orders target) stream →
                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn
                      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightGenerator setGen hinfinite selection orders (ρ - ε))
                      (family target) stream ∧
                    (ρ - ε) / 2 ≤
                      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementBasedLowerDensity
                        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightGenerator setGen hinfinite selection orders
                          (ρ - ε))
                        (orders target) stream

docstring:
The limiting form of Claim 6.17: asymptotic displacement `q` gives
element lower density at least `1/q`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementLowerDensity_of_asymptoticDisplacement
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (q : ℝ),
  0 < q →
    Function.Injective output →
      (∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → output n ∈ K.carrier) →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.AsymptoticDisplacementAtMost K output q →
          1 / q ≤ K.lowerDensity (Set.range output)

docstring:
A single displacement bound turns global output distinctness and late
validity into an element-density lower bound.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementLowerDensity_of_boundedDisplacement
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (M : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    Function.Injective output →
      (∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → output n ∈ K.carrier) →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K output K.carrier M →
          1 / M ≤ K.lowerDensity (Set.range output)

docstring: The set of all values ever output on a run.

Avoiding all previous outputs at every round makes the output stream

    Function.Injective (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementOutputStream gen stream)

docstring:
Definition 6: empirical noise rate in the first `n` inputs.

The artificial zero-length prefix is assigned rate zero.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α → GenLimit.Generic.Language α → ℕ → ℝ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_eq_of_eq_on_prefix
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {stream₁ stream₂ : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) {n : ℕ},
  (∀ i < n, stream₁ i = stream₂ i) →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream₁ L n =
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream₂ L n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_eq_rejectedFraction
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream L n =
    GenLimit.Generic.rejectedFraction (fun t => stream t ∈ L) (Finset.range n)

docstring:
The empirical union bound indexed by languages rather than by distinct
language sets.  Repeated languages merely duplicate a nonnegative summand,
so the indexed form is the one needed for the source's geometric thresholds.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_indexedCommonCore_le_sum
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (S : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream
      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family S)) n ≤
    ∑ i ∈ S, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream (family i) n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_inter_le_add
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (A B : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream (A ∩ B) n ≤
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream A n +
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream B n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_le_one
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream L n ≤ 1

docstring:
Membership in a bounded Algorithm 4 priority class forces every
sufficiently late empirical rate below its assigned threshold.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_le_threshold_of_boundedPriority
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (threshold : ℕ → ℝ)
  {p i n : ℕ},
  i ∈
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family threshold) p →
    p < n + 1 → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream (family i) n ≤ threshold i

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_nonneg
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  0 ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream L n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate_zero
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream L 0 = 0

docstring:
Number of distinct elements of `L` appearing in the first `n` stream
positions.  This is the source quantity `|L ∩ {x₁, ..., xₙ}|`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount
type: GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ → Set ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount_eq_trueCount_of_injective
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  Function.Injective stream →
    ∀ (L : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ),
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount stream L n =
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.trueCount stream L n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount_le
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (L : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount stream L n ≤ n

docstring:
For an injective output stream, counting displayed values in its own
range and in `K` is the same as counting target-valid output times.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount_outputRange_inter
type:
∀ (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  Function.Injective output →
    ∀ (K : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ),
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount output (Set.range output ∩ K) n =
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.trueCount output K n

docstring:
Empirical fraction of distinct displayed points lying in `L`.  As for
canonical prefix ratios, the empty prefix receives value zero.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio
type: GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ → Set ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio_eq_one_sub_noise_of_injective
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  Function.Injective stream →
    ∀ (L : Set ℕ) {n : ℕ},
      0 < n →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L n =
          1 - GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream L n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio_le_one
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (L : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L n ≤ 1

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio_nonneg
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (L : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  0 ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio_outputRange_inter_eq
type:
∀ (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  Function.Injective output →
    ∀ (K : Set ℕ) {n : ℕ},
      0 < n →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio output (Set.range output ∩ K) n =
          1 - GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate output K n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.eventually_correct_on_finite_family
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α)
  (S : Finset (GenLimit.Generic.Language α)),
  (∀ L ∈ S, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn gen L stream) →
    ∃ T, ∀ L ∈ S, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FreshElementCorrectAt gen L stream t

docstring:
An eventual pointwise displacement bound also controls the maximum of
the whole observed prefix once the linear budget absorbs the finite initial
exception.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.eventually_prefixMaxCanonicalRank_le
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (M : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
      ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → ↑(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.prefixMaxCanonicalRank K stream n) ≤ M * ↑n

docstring:
A finite set of indexed targets admits one common eventual correctness
time for a fixed set-valued run.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.eventually_set_correct_on_finite_indices
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language ℕ)
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ),
  (∀ i ∈ S, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetInLimitOn gen (family i) stream) →
    ∃ T, ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetCorrectAt gen (family i) stream t

docstring:
Example 3.3: on the identical one-noise history, every proper output
fails for at least one of the two possible targets.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.example_3_3_single_noise_proper_separation
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexGenerator (Fin 2) ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  ¬(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexCorrectAt GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily gen
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 0) GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.identityStream t ∧
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexCorrectAt GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily gen
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 1) GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.identityStream t)

docstring:
Example 3.4: the same pointwise impossibility holds on the history with
one omission from either possible target.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.example_3_4_single_omission_proper_separation
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexGenerator (Fin 2) ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  ¬(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexCorrectAt GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily gen
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 0) GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.tailFromTwo t ∧
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IndexCorrectAt GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily gen
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 1) GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.tailFromTwo t)

docstring: Coded add-only expansion used by Algorithm 3.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_addOnlyExpansion_index
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (z : ℕ) (add : Finset ℕ),
  ∃ j,
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionBaseIndex j = z ∧
      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language j = O.language z ∪ ↑add

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_algorithmNine_boundedPriorityClass
type:
∀ (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (family : ℕ → Set ℕ) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage)
  (ε M : ℝ) (target : ℕ),
  (∃ T, ∀ (n : ℕ), T ≤ n → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.AlgorithmNineGoodAt stream family orders ε M target n) →
    ∃ p,
      target ∈
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices
          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmNinePriorityTrace stream family orders ε M) p

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_available_in_ordered_prefix
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (A : Set ℕ) (forbidden : Finset ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  forbidden.card < K.prefixCount A m → ∃ i < m, K.enumeration i ∈ A ∧ K.enumeration i ∉ forbidden

docstring:
An eventually satisfied threshold gives the target a bounded Algorithm 4
priority, without requiring convergence of the empirical rate.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_boundedPriorityClass_of_eventually_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (threshold : ℕ → ℝ)
  (target : ℕ),
  (∃ T,
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        T ≤ n → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalNoiseRate stream (family target) n ≤ threshold target) →
    ∃ p,
      target ∈
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices
          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family threshold) p

docstring:
Under vanishing target noise and a positive target threshold, Algorithm
4 places the target in some finite stable priority class `𝓛(p)`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_boundedPriorityClass_of_vanishingNoise
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (threshold : ℕ → ℝ)
  (target : ℕ),
  0 < threshold target →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.VanishingNoise stream (family target) →
      ∃ p,
        target ∈
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices
            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family threshold) p

docstring:
A finite family with infinite common core has a single injective stream
that covers every member and has vanishing noise relative to every member.
This is the common-adversary construction used in Theorem 6.11 necessity.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_common_vanishingNoise_presentation
type:
∀ (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ),
  S.Nonempty →
    Set.Infinite
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family S)) →
      ∃ stream,
        Function.Injective stream ∧
          ∀ i ∈ S, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.VanishingNoiseArbitraryOmissionEnumeration stream (family i)

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_eventual_density_cutoff
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (A : Set ℕ) (stage : ℕ),
  ∃ N, ∀ (m : ℕ), N ≤ m → K.lowerDensity A / GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.densitySlack stage ≤ K.prefixRatio A m

docstring:
Lemma 6.7's adaptive alternating-prefix adversary.  Under the finite
asymmetric-difference hypothesis, its limiting stream is a repetition-free
finite-noise, finite-omission presentation of `L₂`, while a cofinal set of
generator outputs is contained in `L₁`.

The construction also waits for correctness on each intervening `L₂`
completion, matching the source's alternating phases even though only the
`L₁` containment is needed by the final liminf argument.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_finiteContamination_alternating_adversary
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ) (L₁ : Set ℕ) (K₂ : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  L₁.Infinite →
    (L₁ \ K₂.carrier).Finite →
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen L₁ →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen K₂.carrier →
          ∃ stream,
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoiseFiniteOmissionEnumeration stream K₂.carrier ∧
              ∃ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setOutput gen stream t ⊆ L₁

docstring:
Every finite-contamination stream is an exact presentation of a coded
member of the expanded family, and that code remembers the original target
index.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.exists_finiteExpansion_index_for_stream
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {z : ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ},
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoiseFiniteOmissionEnumeration stream (O.language z) →
    ∃ j,
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionBaseIndex j = z ∧
        GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream ((GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language j)

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.family_subset_finiteIndexedUnion
type:
∀ (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language ℕ) {S : Finset ℕ} {i : ℕ},
  i ∈ S → family i ⊆ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteIndexedUnion family S

docstring:
Common intersection of a finite family.  For the empty family this is
the whole universe.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore
type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset (GenLimit.Generic.Language α) → GenLimit.Generic.Language α

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_empty
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1}, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore ∅ = Set.univ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_indexedLanguages_empty
type:

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_indexedLanguages_insert
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (i : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore
      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family (insert i S)) =
    family i ∩
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family S)

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_insert
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq (GenLimit.Generic.Language α)] (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α)
  (S : Finset (GenLimit.Generic.Language α)),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore (insert L S) = L ∩ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore S

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_subset_of_index
type:
∀ (family : ℕ → Set ℕ) (indices : Finset ℕ) {i : ℕ},
  i ∈ indices →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family indices) ⊆
      family i

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore_subset_of_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {S : Finset (GenLimit.Generic.Language α)} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},

docstring:
A finite-noise, finite-omission stream is an exact presentation of a
member of Algorithm 2's expanded collection.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteContamination_expansionWitness
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} →

      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoiseFiniteOmissionEnumeration stream L →

docstring: One cutoff which works for every language in a finite selected class.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteDensityCutoff
type: (ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) → Finset ℕ → Set ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteDensityCutoff_spec
type:
∀ (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (selected : Finset ℕ) (A : Set ℕ) (stage : ℕ) {i m : ℕ},
  i ∈ selected →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteDensityCutoff orders selected A stage ≤ m →
      (orders i).lowerDensity A / GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.densitySlack stage ≤ (orders i).prefixRatio A m

docstring: Algorithm 2's finite expansion `(L ∪ add) \ remove`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansion

{α : Type u_1} →
  GenLimit.Generic.Language α → GenLimit.Generic.Language α → GenLimit.Generic.Language α → GenLimit.Generic.Language α

docstring: Base-language index carried by an expansion code.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionBaseIndex

docstring:
Lemma 4.1, Prefix Priority Stabilization.

Beyond one common time:

1. every member of the stable cutoff class has priority at most `p`;
2. every nonmember has priority strictly above `p`; and
3. every member's priority is unchanged by the next round.

The lower bound `i ≤ priority i n` handles all indices above `p`; only the
finite range through `p` must be synchronized.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_4_1_prefix_priority_stabilization
type:
∀ (priorityTrace : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Monotone (priorityTrace i)) →
    (∀ (i n : ℕ), i ≤ priorityTrace i n) →
      ∀ (p : ℕ),
        ∃ N,
          p ≤ N ∧
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              N ≤ n →
                (∀ i ∈ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices priorityTrace p, priorityTrace i n ≤ p) ∧
                  (∀ i ∉ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices priorityTrace p, p < priorityTrace i n) ∧
                    ∀ i ∈ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices priorityTrace p,
                      priorityTrace i (n + 1) = priorityTrace i n

      ∀ (p target : ℕ),
        target ∈ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices trace p →

                (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityLanguages family trace p)) →

                T ≤ n →
                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore

∀ {α : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (trace : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Monotone (trace i)) →
    (∀ (i n : ℕ), i ≤ trace i n) →
      ∀ (p : ℕ),
        Set.Infinite
            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore
              (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityLanguages family trace p)) →
          ∃ T,
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              T ≤ n →
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityIndices trace p ⊆
                    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFourIndices family (fun i => trace i n) n ∧
                  Set.Infinite
                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore
                      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.indexedLanguages family
                        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFourIndices family (fun i => trace i n) n)))

docstring:
Pointwise late density guarantee used to pass from the critical language
to the set output after deleting the observed sample.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_6_8_eventually_lowerDensity
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (c : ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (orders j).lowerDensity (O.language i)) →
    ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {z : ℕ},
      GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream (O.language z) →
        Function.Injective stream →
          ∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            c ≤
              (orders z).lowerDensity
                (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setOutput (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O)
                  stream t)

docstring: Lemma 6.8's run-wise correctness conclusion.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_6_8_noiseless_generation
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    Function.Injective stream →
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O) (O.language z) stream

docstring:
Lemma 6.8: the explicit indexed-family noiseless set generator is
eventually valid and achieves the prescribed set-based lower density on
every exact repetition-free presentation.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_6_8_noiseless_setDensity
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (orders j).lowerDensity (O.language i)) →
        ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {z : ℕ},
          GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream (O.language z) →
            Function.Injective stream →
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
                  (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O) (orders z).carrier stream ∧
                c ≤
                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedLowerDensity
                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O) (orders z) stream

docstring:
General measurement form of Lemma 6.8.  Correctness is with respect to
the indexed target language, while density may be measured in a separately
supplied ordered reference.  The finite-expansion reduction in Lemma 6.9
uses this with the original target's canonical order.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_6_8_noiseless_setDensity_with_measure
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (measure : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (c : ℝ),
  (∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (measure j).lowerDensity (O.language i)) →
    ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {z : ℕ},
      GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream (O.language z) →
        Function.Injective stream →
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
              (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O) (O.language z) stream ∧
            c ≤
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedLowerDensity
                (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator O) (measure z) stream

docstring:
Lemma 6.9, including the concrete finite-expansion enumeration, the
noiseless positive-density subroutine, and correctness transfer back to the
original target.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_6_9_finiteContamination_sufficiency
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (orders j).lowerDensity (O.language i)) →
        ∀ {z : ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ},
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoiseFiniteOmissionEnumeration stream (O.language z) →
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
                (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator
                  (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O))
                (orders z).carrier stream ∧
              c ≤
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedLowerDensity
                  (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiselessDensityGenerator
                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O))
                  (orders z) stream

docstring:
Lemma 7.5 (`Change of Density`), combining its lower- and upper-density
conclusions.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_change_of_density
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
          1 / M * Filter.liminf (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L) Filter.atTop ≤
              K.lowerDensity L ∧
            1 / M * Filter.limsup (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L) Filter.atTop ≤
              K.upperDensity L

docstring:
Lemma 7.5's eventual finite-prefix inequality for a positive natural
displacement factor.  It absorbs the finitely many pre-stabilization ranks
into a larger time threshold and then applies `lemma_7_5_finite_prefix_core`.

The source allows a real displacement factor.  This natural-factor theorem is
the exact discrete layer needed before ceilings and asymptotic density
transport enter.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_eventual_prefix_count_nat
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℕ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier ↑M →
          ∃ N,
            ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount stream L n ≤ K.prefixCount L (M * n)

docstring:
Lemma 7.5's finite-prefix inequality for an arbitrary positive real
displacement factor.  The ceiling is the exact integral prefix length needed
to contain every rank bounded by the real number `M * n`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_eventual_prefix_count_real
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
          ∃ N,
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              N ≤ n →
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount stream L n ≤
                  K.prefixCount L (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M n)

docstring:
The finite counting inequality in ratio form.  Its right-hand side is
the canonical prefix ratio sampled at `⌈M n⌉`, multiplied by the exact
ceiling scale `⌈M n⌉ / n`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_eventual_ratio_comparison
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L n ≤
              ↑(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M n) / ↑n *
                K.prefixRatio L (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M n)

docstring:
If every displayed point in a prefix has ambient canonical rank at most
`m`, then the distinct displayed target points fit inside the first `m`
canonical positions of the ambient language.

This is the finite set inclusion/cardinality argument at the heart of
Lemma 7.5.  Ranks are intentionally taken with respect to `K`, not merely
with respect to `L`: an `L`-rank bound alone does not imply containment in a
prefix of the canonical ordering of `K`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_finite_prefix_core
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (n m : ℕ),
      (∀ i < n, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.canonicalRank K K.carrier (stream i) ≤ m) →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetCount stream L n ≤ K.prefixCount L m

docstring: Lemma 7.5, lower-density half, in the source's exact orientation.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_lowerDensity
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
          1 / M * Filter.liminf (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L) Filter.atTop ≤
            K.lowerDensity L

docstring:
Lemma 7.5, upper-density half, again with the exact real displacement
factor rather than an integer relaxation.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.lemma_7_5_upperDensity
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  ∀ L ⊆ K.carrier,
    ∀ (M : ℝ),
      0 < M →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement K stream K.carrier M →
          1 / M * Filter.limsup (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio stream L) Filter.atTop ≤
            K.upperDensity L

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.liminf_empiricalTargetRatio_outputRange_inter_eq_one
type:
∀ (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  Function.Injective output →
    ∀ (K : Set ℕ),
      (∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → output n ∈ K) →
        Filter.liminf (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.empiricalTargetRatio output (Set.range output ∩ K)) Filter.atTop =
          1

docstring:
Filling the bounded gaps shows that sampling canonical prefix ratios at
`⌈M n⌉` preserves their liminf.  This is the analytic step that cofinality
alone does not provide.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.liminf_prefixRatio_scaledPrefix
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (L : Set ℕ) (M : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    Filter.liminf (fun n => K.prefixRatio L (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M n)) Filter.atTop =
      K.lowerDensity L

docstring:
The same bounded-gap argument preserves the limsup at the scaled
canonical prefixes.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.limsup_prefixRatio_scaledPrefix
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (L : Set ℕ) (M : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    Filter.limsup (fun n => K.prefixRatio L (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M n)) Filter.atTop =
      K.upperDensity L

docstring:
The next scaled prefix lies strictly to the right of the original

∀ (M : ℝ),
  0 < M →
    ∀ (k : ℕ), k < GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.scaledPrefix M (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.descaledPrefix M k + 1)

docstring: Largest prefix accepted by Algorithm 7's density stopping rule.

type: (ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language ℕ) → (ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) → ℝ → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

docstring:
The largest `k ≤ n` for which the first `k` current languages have an
infinite common intersection.  `Nat.findGreatest` returns zero if no such
prefix exists; correctness is only used once a known infinite prefix has
entered the current window.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.maximalInfinitePrefixSize
type: {α : Type u_1} → (ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.maximalInfinitePrefixSize_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (score : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.maximalInfinitePrefixSize family score n ≤ n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.maximalInfinitePrefix_infinite_of_candidate
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (score : ℕ → ℕ) {n k : ℕ},

    Set.Infinite
        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore

        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.mem_algorithmFiveActiveIndices
type:
∀ {family : ℕ → Set ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {t i : ℕ},
  i ∈ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFiveActiveIndices family stream t ↔
    i < t ∧ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t) ⊆ family i

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.mem_algorithmFivePrefixIndices
type:
∀ {family : ℕ → Set ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ} {t k i : ℕ},
  i ∈ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFivePrefixIndices family stream t k ↔
    i < t ∧ i < k ∧ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t) ⊆ family i

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.mem_boundedPriorityIndices
type:

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.mem_generatedBefore_iff
type:

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.mem_range_tailFromTwo_iff
type: ∀ {x : ℕ}, x ∈ Set.range GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.tailFromTwo ↔ 2 ≤ x

docstring: The canonical order on Lean's natural numbers.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder
type: GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage

docstring:
Exact finite-prefix formula: the first `n` naturals contain
`(n+1)/2` even values.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder_prefixCount_even
type:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixCount GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals n = (n + 1) / 2

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder_prefixCount_even_two_mul
type:
∀ (d : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixCount GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals (2 * d) = d

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder_prefixCount_even_two_mul_add_one
type:

  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixCount GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals (2 * d + 1) =
    d + 1

docstring: Exact finite-prefix count for the arbitrary-density witness.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder_prefixCount_floorIncrementLanguage
type:
∀ (p : ℝ),
  0 ≤ p →
    p ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixCount
            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.floorIncrementLanguage p) n =
          ⌊p * ↑n⌋₊

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder_prefixRatio_even_bounds
type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  0 < n →
    1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixRatio GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals n ∧
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder.prefixRatio GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals n ≤
        1 / 2 + 1 / ↑n

docstring:
No member of the two-language collection is contained in both possible
targets.  This is the semantic obstruction behind both proper-learning
separations.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.no_common_proper_hypothesis
type:
∀ (i : Fin 2),
  ¬(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily i ⊆ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 0 ∧
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily i ⊆ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.coSingletonFamily 1)

docstring: Number of contaminated occurrences among the first `n` inputs.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α → GenLimit.Generic.Language α → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount_eq_of_eq_on_prefix

  (∀ i < n, stream₁ i = stream₂ i) →

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount_inter_le_add

  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount stream (A ∩ B) n ≤
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount stream A n + GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount stream B n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount stream L n ≤ n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.noiseCount_le_finiteNoise_card

Extend a finite history by a fixed fallback value.  Quantities computed
from prefixes of length at most `t` are independent of the fallback.

The empty ranked prefix makes every output of the set-valued priority
generator infinite.

type:
∀ (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language ℕ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (family i)) →

docstring:
Proposition 6.3, stated with a separate ordered reference target.  This
slightly more general form is what Theorem 6.1 needs after adding finitely
many noisy points to the target language.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.proposition_6_3_algorithmFive
type:
∀ (family : ℕ → Set ℕ) (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (z : ℕ) {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ},
  Function.Injective stream →
    Set.range stream ⊆ family z →
      ∀ d ≤ K.lowerDensity (Set.range stream),
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFiveGenerator family) (family z) stream ∧
          d ≤
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedUpperDensity
              (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFiveGenerator family) K stream

docstring:
Proposition 7.4: bounded displacement is closed under language subsets.

The shared ambient ordering is essential: the ordering of `L'` must be
obtained by deleting points from the ordering of `L`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.proposition_7_4_boundedDisplacement_subset
type:

docstring:
Theorem 5.1, with the source's Algorithm 4 fully assembled.

For every countable family of infinite languages there is one finite-history
generator that succeeds on every target under every repetition-free stream
with vanishing noise and arbitrary omissions.  The proof is deterministic;
no probability space is involved.  The separate theorem
`algorithmFourGenerator_fresh_every_round` verifies Definition 3's global
sample/output freshness condition for this same concrete generator.

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (family i)) →
    ∃ gen,
      ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α),
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.VanishingNoiseArbitraryOmissionEnumeration stream (family target) →
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn gen (family target) stream

docstring:

        (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore
          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.boundedPriorityLanguages family
            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.geometricThreshold)
            p))

Source diagnostic for the proof text following Theorem 5.1.

That proof writes `Cl(𝓛(p)) ⊇ K` after noting that the target `K` belongs
to `𝓛(p)`.  The containment is reversed: an intersection is contained in
each member.  The co-singleton example below shows that the printed
containment can be strict and false.

GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.containmentDiagnosticFamily ⊆ Set.univ ∧
  ¬Set.univ ⊆ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteCommonCore GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.containmentDiagnosticFamily

docstring:
Theorem 6.15: the literal Algorithm 8 converts an eventually
`ρ`-dense set generator satisfying the selected-core interface into a fresh
element generator of lower density at least `ρ / 2`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_15_algorithmEight
type:
∀ (setGen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ)
  (hinfinite : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator setGen) (family : ℕ → Set ℕ)
  (selection : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → ℕ) → Finset ℕ) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetCoreSelectionInvariant setGen family selection →
      (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = family i) →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankFallback.InheritsAmbientOrder (orders i)) →
          ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
            (∃ N, ∀ (t : ℕ), N ≤ t → target ∈ selection t fun i => stream ↑i) →
              (∃ N,
                  ∀ (t : ℕ),
                    N ≤ t →
                      ρ ≤ (orders target).lowerDensity (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setOutput setGen stream t)) →
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn
                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightGenerator setGen hinfinite selection orders ρ)
                    (family target) stream ∧
                  ρ / 2 ≤
                    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.elementBasedLowerDensity
                      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmEightGenerator setGen hinfinite selection orders ρ)
                      (orders target) stream

docstring:
Theorem 6.15's exact analytic endpoint once Algorithm 8 has established
Claim 6.17's asymptotic rank bound.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_15_density_endgame
type:
∀ (K : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (output : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    Function.Injective output →
      (∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → output n ∈ K.carrier) →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.AsymptoticDisplacementAtMost K output (2 / ρ) →
          ρ / 2 ≤ K.lowerDensity (Set.range output)

docstring:
Theorem 6.18's reduction for explicit finite-expansion and ordering
interfaces.  `hmeasure` records the paper's ambient-canonical-order fact:
the finite expansion and its base language give the same density to every
output set.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_18_finiteContamination_transfer
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders expansionOrders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    (∀ (j : ℕ),
        (expansionOrders j).carrier = (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language j) →
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (A : GenLimit.Language),
          (expansionOrders j).lowerDensity A =
              (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionMeasure orders j).lowerDensity A ∧
            (expansionOrders j).upperDensity A =
              (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionMeasure orders j).upperDensity A) →
        ∀ (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator ℕ) (ρlow ρup : ℝ),
          (∀ (j : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
              GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream
                  ((GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language j) →
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn gen
                    ((GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language j) stream ∧
                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.ElementDensityGuaranteeOn gen (expansionOrders j) stream ρlow ρup) →
            ∀ (z : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoiseFiniteOmissionEnumeration stream (O.language z) →
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesElementInLimitOn gen (O.language z) stream ∧
                  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.ElementDensityGuaranteeOn gen (orders z) stream ρlow ρup

docstring:
Theorem 6.1 for an explicitly indexed countable family.  The omission
parameter appears only through the exact lower-density premise
`1 - c ≤ μ_low(range stream ∩ K, K)`; the generator itself does not know `c`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_1_algorithmFive
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    ∀ (z : ℕ) (c : ℝ) {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ},
      Function.Injective stream →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.FiniteNoise stream (O.language z) →
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.OmissionsAtMost stream (orders z) c →
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
                (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFiveGenerator
                  (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language)
                (orders z).carrier stream ∧
              1 - c ≤
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedUpperDensity
                  (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmFiveGenerator
                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.finiteExpansionOracleFamily O).language)
                  (orders z) stream

docstring:
Full arbitrary-constant instance of Theorem 6.4.

For every omission allowance `c ∈ (0,1)`, the explicit two-language family
`{floorIncrementLanguage (1-c), ℕ}` defeats every uniform generator at
every requested upper-density level strictly above `1-c`.  The same
repetition-free stream is a complete noiseless enumeration of the smaller
language and a noiseless `c`-omission enumeration of the larger one.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_4_arbitrary_constant
type:
∀ (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1) (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    ∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ),
      ¬GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GuaranteesSetBasedUpperDensityUnderOmissionsOn gen
          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theoremSixFourFamily (1 - c))
          (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theoremSixFourOrders (1 - c) ⋯ ⋯) c (1 - c + ε)

docstring: The concrete `1/2` instance of Theorem 6.4.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_4_half_density_instance
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetInLimitOn gen GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenStream →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedUpperDensity gen GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenStream ≤
      1 / 2

docstring:
Impossibility form matching the source prose: the same stream cannot
force eventual validity for the even target while attaining upper density
strictly above one half when interpreted as a presentation with one-half
omissions from `ℕ`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_4_no_better_than_half
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ),
  ¬(GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetInLimitOn gen GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenNaturals
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenStream ∧
      1 / 2 <
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedUpperDensity gen GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.naturalOrder
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.evenStream)

docstring: General semantic obstruction behind Theorem 6.4.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_4_semantic_obstruction
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ) (K₂ : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (L₁ : Set ℕ)
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetInLimitOn gen L₁ stream →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setBasedUpperDensity gen K₂ stream ≤ K₂.lowerDensity L₁

docstring:
Theorem 6.5, combining the existing alternating-adversary necessity with
Lemma 6.9's explicit finite-expansion sufficiency.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_5_lowerDensity_characterization_enumerated
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∃ gen,
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator gen ∧
            ∀ (z : ℕ),
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen (orders z).carrier ∧
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GuaranteesSetBasedLowerDensityUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen (orders z)
                  c) ↔
        ∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (orders j).lowerDensity (O.language i)

docstring:
Complete collection-level necessity direction of Theorem 6.5.  If one
generator succeeds under finite contamination and guarantees lower density
`c` on every ordered language in `𝓒`, then every ordered pair `L, L' ∈ 𝓒`
whose asymmetric difference `L.carrier \ L'.carrier` is finite satisfies the
paper's required lower-density bound.

This theorem is only the necessity direction; it makes no sufficiency
claim.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_5_lowerDensity_complete_necessity
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ) (𝓒 : Set GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (c : ℝ),
  (∀ K ∈ 𝓒, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen K.carrier) →
    (∀ K ∈ 𝓒, GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GuaranteesSetBasedLowerDensityUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen K c) →
      ∀ ⦃L L' : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage⦄,
        L ∈ 𝓒 → L' ∈ 𝓒 → Set.Finite (L.carrier \ L'.carrier) → c ≤ L'.lowerDensity L.carrier

docstring:
Necessity direction of Theorem 6.5, at the exact pair of targets used by
the source proof.  Any lower-density guarantee on `L₂` is bounded by the
ordered lower density of `L₁` inside `L₂` whenever `L₁ \ L₂` is finite.

This is only the necessity implication; no sufficiency claim is made.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_5_lowerDensity_necessity
type:
∀ (gen : GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.SetGenerator ℕ) (L₁ : Set ℕ) (K₂ : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  L₁.Infinite →
    (L₁ \ K₂.carrier).Finite →
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen L₁ →
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen K₂.carrier →
          ∀ (c : ℝ),
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GuaranteesSetBasedLowerDensityUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen K₂ c →
              c ≤ K₂.lowerDensity L₁

docstring:
Sufficiency direction of Theorem 6.5 for an explicitly indexed countable
family.  One generator works simultaneously for every target and every
finite-noise, finite-omission enumeration.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_6_5_lowerDensity_sufficiency_enumerated
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = O.language i) →
    ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ (i j : ℕ), Set.Finite (O.language i \ O.language j) → c ≤ (orders j).lowerDensity (O.language i)) →
        ∃ gen,
          GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.IsInfiniteSetGenerator gen ∧
            ∀ (z : ℕ),
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesSetUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen (orders z).carrier ∧
                GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GuaranteesSetBasedLowerDensityUnderFiniteContaminationOn gen (orders z) c

docstring:
Theorem 7.8 for an explicitly indexed countable family.  The result
includes the literal finite-history generator, global infinite outputs,
eventual Definition 4 correctness, and the eventual `(1 - ε) / M`
set-density guarantee.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.theorem_7_8_algorithmNine
type:
∀ (family : ℕ → Set ℕ),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), (family i).Infinite) →
    ∀ (orders : ℕ → GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage),
      (∀ (i : ℕ), (orders i).carrier = family i) →
        ∀ (ε M : ℝ),
          0 < ε →
            ε < 1 →
              0 < M →
                ∀ (target : ℕ) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ),
                  Function.Injective stream →
                    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.VanishingNoise stream (family target) →
                      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.BoundedDisplacement (orders target) stream (orders target).carrier
                          M →
                        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.GeneratesInfiniteSetInLimitOn
                            (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmNineSetGenerator family orders ε M) (family target)
                            stream ∧
                          ∃ T,
                            ∀ (t : ℕ),
                              T ≤ t →
                                (1 - ε) / M ≤
                                  (orders target).lowerDensity
                                    (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.setOutput
                                      (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.algorithmNineSetGenerator family orders ε M)
                                      stream t)

docstring:
Algorithm 4's `Nᵢ⁽ⁿ⁾`: the maximum of `1` and one plus the latest
prefix at which the empirical noise rate violates the threshold.

For the source's positive thresholds, the zero-length prefix is never a
violation.  Hence this is exactly its displayed recurrence: the value is
`1` when every nonempty prefix through `n` meets the threshold, and it is
`m + 1` when `m` is the latest violating prefix (in particular, `n + 1`
when the current prefix violates).
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty
type: (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_eq_of_eq_through
type:
∀ {rate₁ rate₂ : ℕ → ℝ} (threshold : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  (∀ m ≤ n, rate₁ m = rate₂ m) →
    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate₁ threshold n =
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate₂ threshold n

docstring:
Once every later empirical rate meets the threshold, no new violation
can change Algorithm 4's penalty.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_eq_of_eventually_le
type:
∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ) {T n : ℕ},
  (∀ (m : ℕ), T ≤ m → rate m ≤ threshold) →
    T ≤ n →
      GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold n =
        GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold T

docstring:
If no prefix through `n` violates the threshold, Algorithm 4's counter
has its source-defined baseline value `1`.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_eq_one_of_forall_le
type:
∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  (∀ m ≤ n, rate m ≤ threshold) → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold n = 1

docstring:
A current threshold violation sets the penalty to exactly `n+1`,
matching the second branch of Algorithm 4.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_eq_time_succ_of_violation
type:
∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ) {n : ℕ},
  threshold < rate n → GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold n = n + 1

docstring:
A rate tending to zero makes every positive-threshold penalty eventually
constant.  This is the exact bounded-priority fact used for the target
language in Theorem 5.1.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_eventually_constant_of_tendsto_zero
type:
∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) {threshold : ℝ},
  0 < threshold →
    Filter.Tendsto rate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      ∃ T,
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          T ≤ n →
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold n =
              GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold T

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_le_time_succ
type: ∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ) (n : ℕ), GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold n ≤ n + 1

docstring:
The threshold penalty is monotone in time, as required by the priority
template's Lemma 4.1.
name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty_mono
type: ∀ (rate : ℕ → ℝ) (threshold : ℝ), Monotone (GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPenalty rate threshold)

docstring:
Algorithm 4's natural-valued priority.  With Lean index `i`
corresponding to source index `i + 1`, this is the source priority
`(i + 1) + Nᵢ⁽ⁿ⁾` minus the same constant `1` for every language, and
therefore induces exactly the source ordering.

type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α → (ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace_eventually_constant_of_vanishingNoise
type:

    GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.VanishingNoise stream (family i) →
      ∃ T,
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          T ≤ n →
            GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family threshold i n =

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace_index_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (threshold : ℕ → ℝ)
  (i n : ℕ), i ≤ GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace stream family threshold i n

name: GenLimit.InfiniteContamination.thresholdPriorityTrace_mono
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (family : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (threshold : ℕ → ℝ)

docstring:
A history-sensitive batch generator.  At round `n` it receives the
adversary's stages `0,...,n` and its own previous cumulative stage, then
returns the next finite batch.

The displayed source type mentions only the current adversarial and previous
generated sets, while its algorithms also maintain counters, previous input,
pods, and intersection chains.  Supplying the finite histories is the
standard total functional encoding of that state: a deterministic routine
can replay its internal counters and pods from the adversarial history.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchGenerator
type: Type

docstring:
A source-shaped certificate for the `k`-batched pods lower bound.  The
eventual prefix inequality is precisely the output of the appendix charging
argument; all limit arithmetic is checked below.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate
type:
GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage →
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion → GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion → ℕ → Type

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate.lowerRecall_div
GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate.mk
type:
{target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage} →
  {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language} →
    {adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion} →
      {k : ℕ} →
        (overhead : ℕ → ℝ) →
          Filter.Tendsto overhead Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                target.prefixRatio adversary.limit n ≤ ↑(k + 1) * target.prefixRatio guess.limit n + overhead n) →
              GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Novel adversary guess →
                GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1 →
                  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerTailPrecision L guess = 1 →
                    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate target L adversary guess k

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate.novel
GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate.overhead
type:
{target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage} →
  {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language} →
    {adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion} →

        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f
          (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedExhaustion
            (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.noNoveltyExplorationGenerator spacing) adversary)

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generated_increment_noNoveltyExplorationGenerator

∀ (spacing : ℕ) (adversary : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion) (n : ℕ),

      (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedStages
        (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.noNoveltyExplorationGenerator spacing) adversary n)

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount_eq_filter_card
type:
∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (S : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L S = {x ∈ S | x ∉ L}.card

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount_generatedStage_le_explorationCount_adversaryCard
type:
∀ {spacing : ℕ},
  0 < spacing →
    ∀ {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language}

      adversary.limit ⊆ L →
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L
              (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedStages
                (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.noNoveltyExplorationGenerator spacing) adversary n) ≤
            GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.explorationCount
              (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.quadraticCarrier spacing) (adversary.stage n).card

∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (S : Finset ℕ),

docstring:
If every increment after a prefix has rejected fraction at most `ε`,
then the cumulative rejected count is bounded by the prefix error plus
`ε` times the cumulative output count.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount_stage_le_prefix_add_rate
type:
∀ {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language} {guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion}
  {N : ℕ} {ε : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ε →
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        N < n →
          ↑(GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.increment n)) ≤ ε * ↑(guess.increment n).card) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ),
        N ≤ n →
          ↑(GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.stage n)) ≤
            ↑(GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.stage N)) + ε * ↑(guess.stage n).card

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount_stage_succ
type:
∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion)
  (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.stage (n + 1)) =
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.stage n) +
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (guess.increment (n + 1))

docstring: Rejected counts add across disjoint finite samples.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount_union_of_disjoint
type:
∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) {S T : Finset ℕ},
  Disjoint S T →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L (S ∪ T) =
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L S + GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L T

docstring: Cumulative hallucination fraction, assigning zero to an empty guess.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction
type: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language → Finset ℕ → ℝ

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction_eq
type:
∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (S : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L S =
    if S.card = 0 then 0 else ↑(GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L S) / ↑S.card

docstring:
Pointwise control of invalid counts yields the corresponding error-rate
control whenever the guess stage is nonempty.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction_le_of_count_le
type:
∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) {S : Finset ℕ} {b : ℕ},
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidCount L S ≤ b →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L S ≤ if S.card = 0 then 0 else ↑b / ↑S.card

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction_le_one

∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (S : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L S ≤ 1

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction_nonneg

∀ (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (S : Finset ℕ),

  E.limit ⊆ L → ∀ (n : ℕ), GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L (E.stage n) = 0

docstring:
Vanishing rejected fractions in the successive increments give a
vanishing cumulative rejected fraction, provided the exhaustion has
infinitely many distinct outputs.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction_stage_tendsto_zero_of_increment_tendsto_zero
type:
∀ {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language} {guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion},
  Set.Infinite guess.limit →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L (guess.increment n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L (guess.stage n)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds 0)

docstring:
Lemma 2.2: optimizing exhaustion-level lower recall over all exhaustions
of the guess language gives its coverage-based lower recall.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lemma_2_2
type:
∀ (target : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion) (guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.bestExhaustionLowerRecall target guess =
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.coverageLowerRecall target guess

docstring:
Lemma 4.5's numerical conclusion, once the batched pod construction has
supplied its charging certificate.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lemma_4_5_of_certificate
type:
∀ {target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage} {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language}
  {adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion} {k : ℕ}
  (hcert : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.BatchedPodsCertificate target L adversary guess k) {α : ℝ},
  α ≤ GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target adversary.limit →
    α / ↑(k + 1) ≤ GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit ∧
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Novel adversary guess ∧
        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1 ∧
          GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerTailPrecision L guess = 1

docstring:
Lemma 4.7.  If the guess eventually contains every target string never
revealed by the adversary, then its lower recall is at least one minus the
adversary's upper recall.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lemma_4_7
type:
∀ (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language),
  target.carrier \ adversary ⊆ guess →
    1 - GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.upperRecall target adversary ≤
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess

docstring:
A bounded real sequence taking values in a finite set has its `liminf`
as an eventually minimal value occurring at an actual finite index.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.liminf_attained_of_mem_finset
type:
∀ (S : Finset ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), p n ∈ S) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ p n) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), p n ≤ 1) →
        ∃ N, p N = Filter.liminf p Filter.atTop ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → Filter.liminf p Filter.atTop ≤ p n

name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.liminf_le_liminf_of_eventually_le_add_tendsto_zero
type:
∀ {u v error : ℕ → ℝ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ u n) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), u n ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), v n ≤ 1) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, u n ≤ v n + error n) →
          Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.liminf u Filter.atTop ≤ Filter.liminf v Filter.atTop

type:
∀ {L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language} {guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion}
  {error : ℕ → ℝ},

    (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.invalidFraction L (guess.stage n) ≤ error n) →
      Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1

        (nhds 0) →
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1

              (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedExhaustion

docstring:
Theorem 2.1, with the paper's standing infinitude of the guess language
made explicit.  Existence of the infinite `f`-bounded guess already implies
the usable cumulative capacity condition on `f`.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.theorem_2_1
type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language)
  (guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
  Set.Infinite guess.limit →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f guess →
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.bestBoundedLowerPrecision f L guess =
        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess

docstring:
Theorem 4.3, with an explicit universal generator.  The construction is
independent of the language family: for every infinite partial adversarial
exhaustion it preserves the same batch bound, explores the whole countable
universe, and attains perfect recall and membership precision.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.theorem_4_3
type:
∀ (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (f : ℕ → ℕ),
  ∃ G,
    ∀ (adversary : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
      Set.Infinite adversary.limit →
        adversary.limit ⊆ L →
          GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f adversary →
            have guess := GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedExhaustion G adversary;
            GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f guess ∧
              GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit = 1 ∧
                GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1

docstring:
Theorem 4.3's conclusion from the concrete algorithm's trace
certificates.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.theorem_4_3_of_certificate
type:
∀ (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (E : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.ExplorationSet)
  (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
  (guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.NoNoveltyCertificate E L f guess →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f guess ∧
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit = 1 ∧
        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1

docstring:
Theorem 4.8's precision and `max(1-β, α/3)` recall conclusion from its
two independently checkable output guarantees.  Novelty is returned as the
certificate's trace predicate.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.theorem_4_8_of_certificate
type:
∀ (E : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.ExplorationSet) (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage)
  (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language)
  (adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.StrictNoveltyCertificate E target L adversary guess →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Novel adversary guess ∧
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1 ∧
        max (1 - GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.upperRecall target adversary.limit)
            (GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target adversary.limit / 3) ≤
          GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit

docstring: Theorem 4.9's full semantic conclusion from the algorithm trace.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.theorem_4_9_of_certificate
type:
∀ (E : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.ExplorationSet) (γ : ℝ) (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage)
  (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language)
  (adversary guess : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
  GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.GammaNoveltyCertificate E γ L adversary guess →
    GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.GammaNovel γ adversary guess ∧
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit = 1 ∧
        GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1

docstring:
Exact appendix baseline: without a novelty requirement, copying the
adversary preserves its recall and batch bound and has perfect precision and
tail precision.
name: GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.valid_generation_without_novelty
type:
∀ (target : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage) (L : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Language) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
  (α : ℝ) (adversary : GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion),
  Set.Infinite adversary.limit →
    adversary.limit ⊆ L →
      GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f adversary →
        α ≤ GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target adversary.limit →
          have guess :=
            GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.generatedExhaustion
              GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.parrotGenerator adversary;
          GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.Exhaustion.BoundedBy f guess ∧
            α ≤ GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerRecall target guess.limit ∧
              GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerMembershipPrecision L guess = 1 ∧
                GenLimit.InfinitelyManyHallucinations.lowerTailPrecision L guess = 1

eventually leaves the `r`-th derivative.

This is precisely the source proof.  If arbitrarily late sequence elements
remained in the `r`-th derivative, basis convergence would make the terminal
language a relative limit point of that derivative, placing it in derivative
`r+1` and contradicting its rank.

      (∀ (n : ℕ), sequence n ≠ terminal) →
        ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → sequence n ∉ GenLimit.KleinbergWei.TowerTopology.cbDerivative X r

accurate selector changes language chooses a fallback contained in the true
target.  The returned vertices are the canonical selector values in their
respective post-observation forests.

type:

  (hr :

  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) →
    GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence C z →
      ∃ T,
        ∀ (round : ℕ),
          T ≤ round →
            ∃ current next,
              ↑current = GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankParent.identifiedPointAt C stream round ∧
                ↑next = GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankParent.identifiedPointAt C stream (round + 1) ∧
                  (↑↑current ≠ ↑↑next →
                    ∃ fallback,
                      GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankFallback.fallbackChoice C stream r hr round
                            current next =
                          some fallback ∧
                        ↑fallback ⊆ C z)

                  GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FiniteRankParent.FrozenFrame C stream r hr originRound
                    laterRound

are solely in the ambient natural-number order.
