docstring:
Corrected concrete semantic form of Theorem 4.1.

The target must have positive prior weight.  `activation` is its first active
round, and `budget` is any division-free dyadic budget satisfying
`totalBound < 2^(budget+1) * initialWeight target`.  The result includes the
trivial possible mistakes before activation and the logarithmic bound after
activation.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_4_1_corrected_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (activeCount : ℕ → ℕ) (initialWeight : ℕ → ℝ) (language : ℕ → Set α)
  (observed : ℕ → α),
  Monotone activeCount →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 ≤ initialWeight i) →
      Function.Injective observed →
        ∀ {totalBound : ℝ},
          (∀ (n : ℕ), GenLimit.MistakeBounded.initialPrefixWeight initialWeight n ≤ totalBound) →
            ∀ (target activation budget : ℕ),
              GenLimit.MistakeBounded.FirstActivated activeCount target activation →
                (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
                  0 < initialWeight target →
                    GenLimit.MistakeBounded.DyadicUpperBudget totalBound (initialWeight target) budget →
                      GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost
                        (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableTargetTrace language
                          (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableSemanticGenerated activeCount initialWeight language
                            observed)
                          target)
                        (activation + budget)

docstring:
The checked halving argument gives the logarithmic part of Theorem 4.1
once the target has entered the active prefix.  Positivity of the initial
target weight is carried by `TargetWeightSurvives`; in particular this
theorem has no zero-weight specialization.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_4_1_positive_weight_after_activation
type:
∀ {trace : GenLimit.MistakeBounded.MistakeTrace} (P : GenLimit.MistakeBounded.HalvingPotential trace)
  {targetWeight totalBound : ℝ} {budget : ℕ},
  GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TargetWeightSurvives P targetWeight →
    P.potential 0 ≤ totalBound →
      GenLimit.MistakeBounded.DyadicUpperBudget totalBound targetWeight budget →
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost trace budget

docstring:
Corrected source-facing numerical wrapper for Theorem 4.1.

There can be at most `activation` mistakes before the target enters the
active prefix, and the positive-weight halving argument permits at most
`budget` further mistakes.  Taking `activation = f⁻¹(i)` and
`budget = ⌊log₂ (W / w₀(i))⌋` recovers the theorem's displayed sum whenever
`0 < w₀(i)`.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_4_1_positive_weight_bound
type:
∀ {trace : GenLimit.MistakeBounded.MistakeTrace} {activation budget : ℕ}
  (P : GenLimit.MistakeBounded.HalvingPotential (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.traceAfter trace activation))
  {targetWeight totalBound : ℝ},
  GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TargetWeightSurvives P targetWeight →
    P.potential 0 ≤ totalBound →
      GenLimit.MistakeBounded.DyadicUpperBudget totalBound targetWeight budget →
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost trace (activation + budget)

docstring:
Corrected dual component of Theorem 5.1: the concrete Algorithm 1
specification simultaneously satisfies the checked logarithmic inequality
and the `d+1` last-mistake threshold forced by the paper's reversed order.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_5_1_corrected_components
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {N : ℕ} (language : Fin N → Set α) (observed generated : ℕ → α) (target : Fin N),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
    Function.Injective observed →
      GenLimit.MistakeBounded.IsFiniteWeightedArgmax language observed generated →
        ∀ {d : ℕ},
          GenLimit.MistakeBounded.FiniteClassClosureDimensionAtMost language d →
            GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost
                (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteTargetTrace language generated target) (min (Nat.log 2 N) (d + 1)) ∧
              GenLimit.MistakeBounded.LastMistakeBefore
                (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteTargetTrace language generated target) (d + 1)

docstring:
Fully instantiated corrected Theorem 5.1 components for the concrete
semantic Algorithm 1 stream.  The `d+1` term is the necessary reversed-order
correction documented by the source diagnostic.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_5_1_corrected_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] {N : ℕ} (language : Fin N → Set α) (observed : ℕ → α) (target : Fin N),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
    Function.Injective observed →
      ∀ {d : ℕ},
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.FiniteClassClosureDimensionAtMost language d →
          GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost
              (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteTargetTrace language
                (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteSemanticGenerated language observed) target)
              (min (Nat.log 2 N) (d + 1)) ∧
            GenLimit.MistakeBounded.LastMistakeBefore
              (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteTargetTrace language
                (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.finiteSemanticGenerated language observed) target)
              (d + 1)

docstring:
A single kernel-checked diagnostic for the printed closure-dimension
bound: the class has dimension at most zero, yet every generator-first
initial output is wrong for at least one target.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_5_1_reversed_order_diagnostic
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {L₀ L₁ : Set α},
  L₀.Infinite →
    L₁.Infinite →
      Disjoint L₀ L₁ →
        ∀ (x : α),
          GenLimit.MistakeBounded.FiniteClassClosureDimensionAtMost (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.disjointPairLanguage L₀ L₁)
              0 ∧
            (x ∉ GenLimit.MistakeBounded.disjointPairLanguage L₀ L₁ 0 ∨
              x ∉ GenLimit.MistakeBounded.disjointPairLanguage L₀ L₁ 1)

docstring:
The exact Basel mass sharpens the robust zero-based theorem by one
mistake, while retaining the original `2ᵗ` schedule.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_6_1_basel_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (language : ℕ → Set α) (observed : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective observed →
    ∀ (target : ℕ),
      (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost
          (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableTargetTrace language
            (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableSemanticGenerated GenLimit.MistakeBounded.doublingActiveCount
              GenLimit.MistakeBounded.polynomialPrior language observed)
            target)
          (3 * Nat.clog 2 (target + 1))

docstring:
Concrete semantic `O(log i)` mistake theorem for Section 6.1.

For zero-based target `target`, Algorithm 1 with the polynomial prior and
doubling active prefix makes at most
`3 * clog₂(target+1) + 1` mistakes on every injective target-consistent
presentation.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_6_1_coarse_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (language : ℕ → Set α) (observed : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective observed →
    ∀ (target : ℕ),
      (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost
          (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableTargetTrace language
            (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableSemanticGenerated GenLimit.MistakeBounded.doublingActiveCount
              GenLimit.MistakeBounded.polynomialPrior language observed)
            target)
          (3 * Nat.clog 2 (target + 1) + 1)

docstring:
The displayed real-valued bound in Theorem 6.1, with the paper's
one-based language index represented as `target+1`.

Because `mistakeCount` is natural-valued, the statement casts it to `ℝ`.
The source's erroneous equality
`⌊log₂ i⌋ + x = log₂ i + x` is replaced here by the valid inequality
`⌊log₂ i⌋ ≤ log₂ i`.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_6_1_displayed_real_bound_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (language : ℕ → Set α) (observed : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective observed →
    ∀ (target : ℕ),
      (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          ↑(GenLimit.MistakeBounded.mistakeCount
                (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableTargetTrace language
                  (GenLimit.MistakeBounded.countableSemanticGenerated GenLimit.MistakeBounded.paperDoublingActiveCount
                    GenLimit.MistakeBounded.polynomialPrior language observed)
                  target)
                t) ≤
            3 * Real.logb 2 (↑target + 1) + Real.logb 2 (Real.pi ^ 2 / 6)

docstring:
Exact integer-valued Theorem 6.1 instantiation.

The first summand is the actual number of zero-based rounds before the
paper's `2ᵗ` schedule activates the one-based language `target+1`; the
second is exactly the floor-log budget printed in Theorem 4.1.
name: GenLimit.MistakeBounded.theorem_6_1_logFloor_concrete_semantic_algorithm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (language : ℕ → Set α) (observed : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective observed →
    ∀ (target : ℕ),
      (∀ (t : ℕ), observed t ∈ language target) →
        GenLimit.MistakeBounded.TotalMistakesAtMost

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.1: two no-sample-generatable classes can have a union
that is not generatable from samples.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_1
type:
∃ C₁ C₂,
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples C₁ ∧
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyGeneratableWithoutSamples C₂ ∧
      ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutRepetitions (C₁ ∪ C₂)

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.2: finite-noise generation is equivalent to generation
without samples, in the uniform and non-uniform settings.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_2
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ),
  GenLimit.Generic.UUS C →
    (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyNoisilyGeneratable C ↔
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyGeneratableWithoutSamples C) ∧
      (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.NonuniformlyNoisilyGeneratable C ↔
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples C)

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.3: no-sample generation is characterized by an
increasing cover with infinite common cores.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_3
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples C ↔
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.HasIncreasingInfiniteCoreCover C

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.4: ordinary generators remain correct under arbitrary
infinite omissions.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_4
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  GenLimit.Generic.UUS C →
    (∀ (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α),
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IsUniformGenerator gen C →
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IsUniformInfiniteOmissionGenerator gen C) ∧
      ∀ (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α),
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IsNonuniformGenerator gen C →
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IsNonuniformInfiniteOmissionGenerator gen C

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.5: one class realizes both adjacent finite-omission and
adjacent known-finite-noise separations.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_5
type:
∀ (i : ℕ),
  ∃ C,
    GenLimit.Generic.UUS C ∧
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithOmissions C i ∧
        ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithOmissions C (i + 1) ∧
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithNoiseLevel C i ∧
            ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithNoiseLevel C (i + 1)

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.6: success at every known finite noise level does not
imply generation under an unknown finite amount of noise.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_6
type:
∃ C,
  (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithNoiseLevel C i) ∧
    ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.NoisilyGeneratableInLimit C

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.7 in Definition 6.1's literal interface: infinite
mandatory-query feedback is strictly stronger than every fixed finite query
budget.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_7
type:
∃ C,
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithTotalFeedback C ∧
    ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutRepetitions C ∧
      ∀ (budget : ℕ), ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithQueries C budget

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.8: every explicitly indexed countable language family
is non-uniformly identifiable with membership feedback.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.Results.theorem_1_8
type: ∀ (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily ℕ), GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.NonuniformlyIdentifiableWithFeedback C

docstring:
A bad point in the frozen core is queried after finitely many rounds,
provided every growing observation sample is still contained in the target.

This discharges the “eventually `v` takes the value `b`” step in the source
proof, including the fact that the positive sample changes during the inner
loop.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.closureSweep_eventually_queries_counterexample
type:
∀ (stage : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackClosureStage) {target : Set ℕ} (observed : ℕ → Finset ℕ)
  (initialCursor counterexample : ℕ),
  (∀ (round : ℕ), ↑(observed round) ⊆ target) →
    counterexample ∈ stage.core →
      counterexample ∉ target →
        initialCursor ≤ counterexample →
          ∃ round, GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.closureSweepQuery stage observed initialCursor round = counterexample

  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) (t : ℕ)
  (observations : Fin (t + 1) → ℕ) (responses : Fin (t + 1) → Option Bool),
  (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.countableCoverFeedbackGenerator components dimensions hdimensions).output t observations
      responses =
    (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions
        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions hdimensions t observations
          fun i => responses i.castSucc)
        (GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample observations)).outputValue

  (observations : Fin (t + 1) → ℕ) (responses : Fin t → Option Bool),

      responses =

        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions hdimensions t observations

        (GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample observations)).queryValue

docstring:
The paper's control-state branch structure for the current positive
sample, represented in the shared optional-query interface.

An inconsistent component consumes one (query-free) round before the outer
loop advances.  This stuttering implementation is extensionally harmless
for an eventual-correctness theorem and makes every state change causal.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction
type:
(components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) →
  (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ) →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) →
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions →
        Finset ℕ → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions

docstring:
While an active frozen core is contained in the target, the causal
controller's query and output are both fresh target points.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_active_correct
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i))
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ)
  (active : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions),
  state.active = some active →
    ∀ {target : Set ℕ},
      (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage.toClosureStage hdimensions active).core ⊆ target →
        have action :=
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state observed;
        action.outputValue ∈ target ∧ action.outputValue ∉ observed

docstring:
Pointwise convergence lemma.  If the sample is large enough and the
outer index does not change across this round, then the action's output is a
fresh target point.  A waiting action is impossible; a skip or negative query
would increase the index; hence the round is a positively answered fresh-core
query.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_correct_of_large_of_index_eq
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) (target : Set ℕ)
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackStateInvariant target state →
    ↑observed ⊆ target →
      dimensions state.nextComponent < observed.card →
        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerNext state
                (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state
                  observed)
                (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse target
                  (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state
                    observed))).nextComponent =
            state.nextComponent →
          have action :=
            GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state
              observed;
          action.outputValue ∈ target ∧ action.outputValue ∉ observed

docstring:
At an index whose component contains the target, the controller cannot

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_ne_skip_of_target
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i))
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ)
  (componentIndex : ℕ),
  state.nextComponent = componentIndex →
    ∀ {target : Set ℕ},
      target ∈ components componentIndex →
        ↑observed ⊆ target →
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state observed ≠
            GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction.skip

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_ne_wait_of_large
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_of_active
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i))
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ)

  state.active = some active →

      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction.query active
        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.leastFreshCorePoint

docstring:

positive entry sample, and a fresh point of its frozen common core.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction_query_spec
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) (target : Set ℕ)
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackStateInvariant target state →
    ↑observed ⊆ target →
      ∀ (active : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions) (candidate : ℕ),
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state observed =
            GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction.query active candidate →
          active.index = state.nextComponent ∧
            ↑active.entrySample ⊆ target ∧
              candidate ∈
                  (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage.toClosureStage hdimensions active).core ∧
                candidate ∉ observed

      counterexample ∉ target →
        cursor ≤ counterexample → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.leastFreshCorePoint stage observed cursor ≤ counterexample

  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.maskedFeedbackResponses gen (n + 1) observations responses i.castSucc =
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.maskedFeedbackResponses gen n (fun j => observations j.castSucc)

  (responses : Fin (n + 1) → Bool),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.maskedFeedbackResponses gen (n + 1) observations responses (Fin.last n) =
    match
      gen.query n observations
        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.maskedFeedbackResponses gen n (fun j => observations j.castSucc) fun j =>
          responses j.castSucc) with
    | none => none
    | some _query => some (responses (Fin.last n))

type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.Generic.Generator α → GenLimit.Generic.Generator α

docstring:
Semantic core of Lemmas A.4--A.5.  A repetition-free generator correct
from paper time `T` becomes correct on a repeated prefix once that prefix has
at least `T + 1` distinct observations.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.repetitionAdapter_correctAt
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] {gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α}
  {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {t T : ℕ},
  Set.Infinite L →
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.RepetitionEnumeration stream L →
      T + 1 ≤ (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.observedThrough stream t).card →
        (∀ (full : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α),
            GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.ExactEnumeration full L →
              ∀ (r : ℕ), T ≤ r → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.CorrectAt gen L full r) →
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.CorrectAt (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.repetitionAdapter gen) L stream t

docstring:
Correctness at raw time `t` is therefore correctness at the matching
paper time of the canonical first-occurrence stream.

∀ {α : Type u_1} {gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α}
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.CorrectAt (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.repetitionAdapter gen) L stream t ↔
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.CorrectAt gen L (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.firstOccurrenceStream stream)
      (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.firstOccurrenceCount stream (t + 1) - 1)

docstring:
At every raw time, the causal adapter's output is exactly the original
generator's output on the corresponding prefix of the canonical
first-occurrence stream.

  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.outputAt (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.repetitionAdapter gen) stream t =
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.outputAt gen (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.firstOccurrenceStream stream)
      (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.firstOccurrenceCount stream (t + 1) - 1)

docstring:
Algorithm 5's simulated output on a nonempty finite observation
history.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackOutput
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α → {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → α) → 0 < n → α

docstring:
Response agreement at every coordinate makes Algorithm 5's restarted
output coincide with the output of the actual feedback execution.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackOutput_eq_actual
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (gen : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α)
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (horizon : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Generic.StreamIn stream L →
    (∀ query ∈ GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.actualQueryValueSet gen L stream,
        query ∈ L → query ∈ GenLimit.Generic.sample stream (horizon + 1)) →
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackOutput gen (fun i => stream ↑i) ⋯ =
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.actualFeedbackOutput gen L stream horizon

docstring:
Algorithm 5's simulated response at position `j`.  Every query is
answered using membership in the entire currently observed finite sample,
while the query itself sees only the causal prefix through `j`.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse
type: {α : Type u_1} → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α → {n : ℕ} → (Fin n → α) → (j : ℕ) → j < n → Option Bool

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse.eq_def
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (gen : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α) {n : ℕ} (observations : Fin n → α) (j : ℕ)
  (hj : j < n),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse gen observations j hj =
    match
      gen.query j (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.observationPrefix observations j hj) fun k =>
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse gen observations ↑k ⋯ with
    | none => none
    | some query => some (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.finiteSampleAnswer observations query)

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse_eq
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (gen : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α) {n : ℕ} (observations : Fin n → α) (j : ℕ)
  (hj : j < n),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse gen observations j hj =
    match
      gen.query j (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.observationPrefix observations j hj) fun k =>
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse gen observations ↑k ⋯ with
    | none => none
    | some query => some (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.finiteSampleAnswer observations query)

docstring:
Once all positively answered actual queries have been observed, the
restarted simulation agrees with the actual response at every position of
the current prefix.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse_eq_actual
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (gen : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackGenerator α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α)
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (horizon : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Generic.StreamIn stream L →
    (∀ query ∈ GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.actualQueryValueSet gen L stream,
        query ∈ L → query ∈ GenLimit.Generic.sample stream (horizon + 1)) →
      ∀ (j : ℕ) (hj : j < horizon + 1),
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.simulatedFeedbackResponse gen (fun i => stream ↑i) j hj =
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.actualFeedbackResponse gen L stream j

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.start_add_le_recordTime

the target itself witnesses consistency and the resulting frozen stage has a

(components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) →
  (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ) →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) →
      (target : Set ℕ) →
        (componentIndex : ℕ) →
          target ∈ components componentIndex →
            (sample : Finset ℕ) →
              ↑sample ⊆ target →
                dimensions componentIndex < sample.card → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.FeedbackClosureStage

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.targetFeedbackClosureStage_core_subset
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) (target : Set ℕ)
  (componentIndex : ℕ) (htarget : target ∈ components componentIndex) (sample : Finset ℕ) (hsample : ↑sample ⊆ target)
  (hlarge : dimensions componentIndex < sample.card),
  (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.targetFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions hdimensions target componentIndex htarget
        sample hsample hlarge).core ⊆
    target

∀ {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily ℕ} {z i t : ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream ℕ},
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.ExactEnumeration stream (C z) →
    C i = C z →
      i < t + 1 →
        i ∈
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.feedbackIdentificationCandidates C t (fun j => stream ↑j) fun j =>
            GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.actualIdentifierResponse (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.algorithmSix C) (C z) stream
              ↑j

docstring: The countable non-uniform component of the fixed Theorem 1.1 witness.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneFirstClass
type: GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ

docstring: The uncountable uniform component of the fixed Theorem 1.1 witness.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneSecondClass
type: GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ

docstring:
A strengthened fixed witness for Theorem 1.1, including the cardinality
properties inherited from the concurrent Paper10 construction.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theorem_1_1_strong_witness
type:
Set.Countable GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneFirstClass ∧
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneFirstClass ∧
    ¬Set.Countable GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneSecondClass ∧
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyGeneratableWithoutSamples GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneSecondClass ∧
        ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutRepetitions
            (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneFirstClass ∪ GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theoremOneSecondClass)

docstring:
A consequence of Theorem 1.1 making both positive guarantees explicit:
each component is generatable both without samples and in the standard model
with adversarial samples.  The union lower bound already holds in the latter,
more permissive model.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theorem_1_1_with_and_without_samples
type:
∃ C₁ C₂,
  (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples C₁ ∧
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.NonuniformlyGeneratableWithoutRepetitions C₁) ∧
    (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyGeneratableWithoutSamples C₂ ∧
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.UniformlyGeneratableWithoutRepetitions C₂) ∧
      ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutRepetitions (C₁ ∪ C₂)

docstring: Summary Theorem 1.3, with the source's complete quantifier order.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theorem_1_3
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),
  GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithoutSamples C ↔
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.HasIncreasingInfiniteCoreCover C

docstring:
Summary Theorem 1.5: the same class witnesses the adjacent-level
separations for finite omissions and for known finite noise.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theorem_1_5
type:
∀ (i : ℕ),
  ∃ C,
    GenLimit.Generic.UUS C ∧
      GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithOmissions C i ∧
        ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithOmissions C (i + 1) ∧
          GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithNoiseLevel C i ∧
            ¬GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.GeneratableInLimitWithNoiseLevel C (i + 1)

docstring: Theorem 1.6, with the source's exact existential quantifiers.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.theorem_1_6
type:
∃ C,

docstring: Truthful response associated with a controller action.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse
type:
{components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ} →
  {dimensions : ℕ → ℕ} →
    Set ℕ → GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions → Option Bool

name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse_active_eq_true
type:
∀ (components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ) (dimensions : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i))
  (state : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerState components dimensions) (observed : Finset ℕ)
  (active : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions),
  state.active = some active →
    ∀ {target : Set ℕ},
      (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage.toClosureStage hdimensions active).core ⊆ target →
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse target
            (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.infiniteFeedbackControllerAction components dimensions hdimensions state
              observed) =
          some true

docstring:
Conversely, querying a frozen-core counterexample produces the negative
response that advances Algorithm 4 to the next component.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse_query_eq_false
type:
∀ {components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ} {dimensions : ℕ → ℕ} (target : Set ℕ)
  (active : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions),
  ∀ candidate ∉ target,
    GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse target
        (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction.query active candidate) =
      some false

docstring:
A query from a component containing the target receives `Yes`: the
frozen common core is a subset of that target.
name: GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse_query_true_of_target_component
type:
∀ {components : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass ℕ} {dimensions : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hdimensions : ∀ (i : ℕ), GenLimit.Generic.HasClosureDimension (components i) (dimensions i)) (target : Set ℕ)
  (active : GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage components dimensions) (candidate : ℕ),
  target ∈ components active.index →
    ↑active.entrySample ⊆ target →
      candidate ∈ (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.IndexedFeedbackClosureStage.toClosureStage hdimensions active).core →
        GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.truthfulControllerResponse target
            (GenLimit.NoiseLossFeedback.InfiniteFeedbackControllerAction.query active candidate) =
          some true

infinite one, then the class cannot have a uniform threshold measured only
in distinct positive observations.

the Limit).

The formal proof supplies the monotonicity step omitted by the prose:
after one prefix has at least `2 * max cutoff d` distinct observations, every
later prefix does too.  Consequently its latest balanced suffix starts after
the finite-noise cutoff and contains at least the target-specific noiseless
threshold.

          d ≤ base.toFinset.card →

                base.toFinset ⊆ (GenLimit.NoisyExamples.iteratedGeneratorHistory Q base j).toFinset ∧

If deleting one hypothesis changes a finite common intersection into an
infinite one, then the class cannot have a uniform threshold measured only
in distinct positive observations.

          Set.Finite (GenLimit.NoisyExamples.commonIntersection F) →

docstring:
The finite answered trace produced by the literal carried-cutoff
transition.  On an active round it covers every cutoff searched up to and
including the first admissible one.  On an inactive round it records the
finite consistency checks needed to discover that no index is active.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace
type:
GenLimit.OracleFamily →
  GenLimit.OracleFamily.CarriedWitnessProtectionState → ℕ → ℕ → GenLimit.OracleFamily.ReplayMembershipTrace

docstring:
On every active round, the explicit finite trace contains every oracle
answer used at every cutoff examined by the repeat-until search.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace_covers_active
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (state : GenLimit.OracleFamily.CarriedWitnessProtectionState) (x t : ℕ)
  (hactive :
    O.HasReplayActive
      (GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionSureUpdate
        { sure := state.sure, pastOutputs := state.pastOutputs, output := state.output } x)
      t),
  let sure :=
    GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionSureUpdate
      { sure := state.sure, pastOutputs := state.pastOutputs, output := state.output } x;
  have lower := GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayCarriedStart state x;
  have cutoff := O.replayCarriedRoundCutoff sure state.pastOutputs t lower hactive;
  (O.carriedWitnessProtectionProcessRound state x t =
      have out := O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure state.pastOutputs t lower hactive;
      { sure := sure, pastOutputs := insert out state.pastOutputs, cutoff := cutoff, output := out }) ∧
    lower ≤ cutoff ∧
      Finset.card (O.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace state x t) ≤ t * (sure.card + cutoff) ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          lower ≤ m →
            m ≤ cutoff →
              ∀ i < t,
                ∀ (y : ℕ), y ∈ sure ∨ y < m → ((i, y), O.query i y) ∈ O.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace state x t

docstring:
On an inactive round the finite trace contains all consistency queries
needed to determine that the active set is empty.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace_covers_inactive
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (state : GenLimit.OracleFamily.CarriedWitnessProtectionState) (x t : ℕ),
  ¬O.HasReplayActive
        (GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionSureUpdate
          { sure := state.sure, pastOutputs := state.pastOutputs, output := state.output } x)
        t →
    have sure :=
      GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionSureUpdate
        { sure := state.sure, pastOutputs := state.pastOutputs, output := state.output } x;
    (O.carriedWitnessProtectionProcessRound state x t =
        have out := GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionFallback sure;
        { sure := sure, pastOutputs := insert out state.pastOutputs, cutoff := state.cutoff, output := out }) ∧
      Finset.card (O.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace state x t) ≤ t * sure.card ∧
        ∀ i < t, ∀ y ∈ sure, ((i, y), O.query i y) ∈ O.carriedWitnessProtectionQueryTrace state x t

docstring:

while the excluded witness set has uniformly bounded cardinality.

starts above an arbitrary carried lower bound.

docstring:
The protected-witness argument is unchanged when the search starts from
a carried lower bound.

  i ∈ O.replayActive sure t →
    j ∈ O.replayActive sure t →
      j < i →
        w ∈ O.language i →
          w ∉ O.language j →
            w ∉ pastOutputs →
              (∀ x < w, x ∈ O.language i → x ∉ O.language j → x ∉ pastOutputs → False) →
                O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive ≠ w

docstring: Complete source-facing certificate for one carried-cutoff round.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayCarriedRoundOutput_spec
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t lower : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  have m := O.replayCarriedRoundCutoff sure pastOutputs t lower hactive;
  have n := O.replaySelected sure pastOutputs t m hactive;
  lower ≤ m ∧
    O.ReplayFinitelyCriticalAt sure pastOutputs m n ∧
      (∀ i < t, O.ReplayFinitelyCriticalAt sure pastOutputs m i → i ≤ n) ∧
        O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive < m ∧
          O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive ∈ O.language n ∧
            O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive ∉ sure ∧
              O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive ∉ pastOutputs ∧
                O.replayCarriedRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t lower hactive ∉ O.replayWitnesses sure pastOutputs t m

docstring:
The least full-domain witness at the first round exposing target index
`i`.  Algorithm 2 subsequently protects this fixed point.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayLeastDifference
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → Finset ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayLeastDifference_minimal
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {i j : ℕ},
  O.HasReplayDifference pastOutputs i j →
    ∀ x < O.replayLeastDifference pastOutputs i j, x ∈ O.language i → x ∉ O.language j → x ∉ pastOutputs → False

name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayLeastDifference_spec
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {i j : ℕ},
  O.HasReplayDifference pastOutputs i j →
    O.replayLeastDifference pastOutputs i j ∈ O.language i ∧
      O.replayLeastDifference pastOutputs i j ∉ O.language j ∧ O.replayLeastDifference pastOutputs i j ∉ pastOutputs

docstring:
The least terminating cutoff for a restart-normalized repeat-until loop.
The source carries its cutoff between rounds and first raises it past the new
observation.  Restarting the finite search at zero changes only query reuse
in the correctness argument: the witness exclusions themselves imply
freshness, and the semantic conclusions of Lemmas 6.3--6.5 are unchanged.
No run-equivalence with the literal carried-cutoff machine is asserted.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundCutoff
type: (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) → (sure : Finset ℕ) → Finset ℕ → (t : ℕ) → O.HasReplayActive sure t → ℕ

name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundCutoff_spec
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  (O.replayAdmissible sure pastOutputs t (O.replayRoundCutoff sure pastOutputs t hactive) hactive).Nonempty

docstring:
The first admissible output chosen at the first terminating cutoff.
This definition is executable relative to `O.query`; the source-facing
carried-cutoff query trace is exposed in `FiniteQueryTrace.lean`.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundOutput
type: (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) → (sure : Finset ℕ) → Finset ℕ → (t : ℕ) → O.HasReplayActive sure t → ℕ

docstring:
Every output of the terminating membership-query round is fresh relative
to both the sure observations and all previous outputs.

∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∉ sure ∧ O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∉ pastOutputs

docstring:
Lemma 6.5's one-round validity argument.  Once the target index is
replay-critical, maximality puts the selected index at or after it; selected
criticality then transports every non-replayed output back into the target.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundOutput_mem_of_targetCritical
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t z : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  z < t →
    O.ReplayFinitelyCriticalAt sure pastOutputs (O.replayRoundCutoff sure pastOutputs t hactive) z →
      O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∈ O.language z

docstring:
Witness-protection invariant for one round.  If `w` is the least
currently un-replayed point separating active `i` from earlier active `j`,
the round cannot output `w`: below the cutoff it is placed in `W^(t,m)`,
while at a smaller cutoff every eligible output is strictly below `w`.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundOutput_ne_leastDifference
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t i j w : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  i ∈ O.replayActive sure t →
    j ∈ O.replayActive sure t →
      j < i →
        w ∈ O.language i →
          w ∉ O.language j →
            w ∉ pastOutputs →
              (∀ x < w, x ∈ O.language i → x ∉ O.language j → x ∉ pastOutputs → False) →
                O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ≠ w

name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replayRoundOutput_spec
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {sure pastOutputs : Finset ℕ} {t : ℕ} (hactive : O.HasReplayActive sure t),
  have m := O.replayRoundCutoff sure pastOutputs t hactive;
  have n := O.replaySelected sure pastOutputs t m hactive;
  O.ReplayFinitelyCriticalAt sure pastOutputs m n ∧
    (∀ i < t, O.ReplayFinitelyCriticalAt sure pastOutputs m i → i ≤ n) ∧
      O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive < m ∧
        O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∈ O.language n ∧
          O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∉ sure ∧
            O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∉ pastOutputs ∧
              O.replayRoundOutput sure pastOutputs t hactive ∉ O.replayWitnesses sure pastOutputs t m

docstring:
Query cache sufficient for every tested cutoff through `cutoff`.

cutoff already contains every query needed at all earlier cutoffs.

docstring: Algorithm 2's `n^(t,m)`: the largest active replay-critical index.

name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.replaySelected_mem

docstring:
One induction step in Lemma 6.3: a fixed least target-versus-earlier
witness cannot enter the output ledger while both indices remain active.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtectionRun_succ_protects_witness
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {z j r : ℕ} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {basePast : Finset ℕ},
  GenLimit.Replay.IsReplaySequence O.witnessProtectionGenerator (O.language z) stream →
    z < r + 1 →
      j < z →
        O.ReplayConsistentAt (O.witnessProtectionRun stream (r + 1)).sure j →
          basePast ⊆ (O.witnessProtectionRun stream r).pastOutputs →
            O.HasReplayDifference basePast z j →
              O.replayLeastDifference basePast z j ∉ (O.witnessProtectionRun stream r).pastOutputs →
                O.replayLeastDifference basePast z j ∉ (O.witnessProtectionRun stream (r + 1)).pastOutputs

Each genuinely separating earlier index is permanently evicted.  Replay
enumeration eventually presents the protected witness; because the machine
has never output it while the index remains active, that occurrence enters
the sure set and witnesses inconsistency forever.

    j < z →
      O.HasReplayDifference (O.witnessProtectionRun stream z).pastOutputs z j →
        ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ¬O.ReplayConsistentAt (O.witnessProtectionRun stream t).sure j

docstring:

receives fresh, target-valid outputs from Witness Protection.

docstring:
The induction from Lemma 6.3.  A least witness fixed immediately before
target index `z` becomes eligible is absent from every later output ledger for
as long as the earlier index remains consistent.
name: GenLimit.OracleFamily.witnessProtection_leastDifference_protected
type:

  GenLimit.Replay.IsReplaySequence O.witnessProtectionGenerator (O.language z) stream →
    j < z →
      O.HasReplayDifference (O.witnessProtectionRun stream z).pastOutputs z j →
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          z + 1 ≤ t →
            O.ReplayConsistentAt (O.witnessProtectionRun stream t).sure j →
              O.replayLeastDifference (O.witnessProtectionRun stream z).pastOutputs z j ∉
                (O.witnessProtectionRun stream t).pastOutputs

docstring:
Lemma 6.3: the true index eventually becomes replay-critical at every
finite cutoff.  Earlier indices with a genuine target witness are evicted by
the preceding theorem; every remaining earlier index already contains the
target modulo the finite output ledger fixed before index `z` became active.

type:

    ∃ T,
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        T ≤ t →
          O.ReplayCriticalAt (O.witnessProtectionRun stream t).sure (O.witnessProtectionRun stream (t - 1)).pastOutputs
            z

docstring:
A completed right-to-left insertion loop.

`oldOrder = left ++ right`; the target is inserted between these lists.
Every language left of the target has strictly smaller finalized
complexity.  Every language crossed into `right` records the exact comparison
that justified its swap.

name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.InsertionSplit.crossed_upper
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {complexity : ℕ → ℕ} {target : ℕ} {oldOrder : List ℕ}
  (self : GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.InsertionSplit F complexity target oldOrder) (before : List ℕ) (i : ℕ)
  (after : List ℕ),
  self.right = before ++ i :: after →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.insertionScore F (self.left ++ before ++ [i]) target ≤ complexity i

∀ {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (F : ℕ → Set α) (stage : ℕ),
  ∃ G time,
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.AchievesTimeVector G F time ∧
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PositiveTimeVector time ∧
        (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MatchesPrefix stage time fun i =>
            (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalProcedureStage F stage).complexity i + 1) ∧
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PrefixParetoOptimal stage (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.RealizableTimeVectors F) time

docstring:

displayed vector `max (g i) (mStar i + 1)`.

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Infinite α] (F : ℕ → Set α) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
  (hf : GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.IsUnboundedScheduler f),
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.AchievesTimeVector (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.schedulerGenerator F f) F
      (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.schedulerTimeVector F f hf) ∧
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PositiveTimeVector (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.schedulerTimeVector F f hf)

docstring:
Theorem 5: finite canonical sublevels yield a generator realizing the
complete canonical Pareto-optimal vector.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.Results.theorem_5
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (F : ℕ → Set α),
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteSublevels (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalComplexity F) →
    ∃ G,
      (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.AchievesTimeVector G F fun i =>
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalComplexity F i + 1) ∧
        (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PositiveTimeVector fun i => GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalComplexity F i + 1) ∧
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.ParetoOptimal (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.RealizableTimeVectors F) fun i =>
            GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalComplexity F i + 1

docstring:
Theorem 6 with the source's empty-candidate initialization totalized:
the concrete noisy scheduler realizes the displayed noisy time vector.

  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.AchievesNoisyTimeVector (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.noisySchedulerGenerator F noise f) F
      noise (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.noisySchedulerTimeVector F noise f hf) ∧
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PositiveTimeVector (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.noisySchedulerTimeVector F noise f hf)

docstring:
Theorem 8: under finite noisy-complexity sublevels, the corrected
Procedure-2 construction realizes a Pareto-optimal canonical noisy vector.

    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.variantCanonicalTime (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalNoisyComplexity F noise) ∈
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyRealizableTimeVectors F noise ∧
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.ParetoOptimal (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyRealizableTimeVectors F noise)
        (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.variantCanonicalTime (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalNoisyComplexity F noise))

docstring:
The exact facts about Procedure 1 used by Observation 3 and Claim 3.1.

`history i` enumerates the finite witness intersection without repetition.
When the complexity is positive, the witness contains the target.  Every
other witness language has an earlier index and strictly lower complexity.

type: {α : Type u_1} → (ℕ → Set α) → (ℕ → ℕ) → Type u_1

type:
{α : Type u_1} →

  (i : ℕ),

name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.WitnessCertificate.history_injective

docstring: Every point in the certified history belongs to every witness language.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.WitnessCertificate.history_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {complexity : ℕ → ℕ} (C : GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.WitnessCertificate F complexity)
  (i j : ℕ), 0 < complexity i → j ∈ C.witness i → ∀ (k : Fin (complexity i)), C.history i k ∈ F j

name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.WitnessCertificate.mk
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {F : ℕ → Set α} →
    {complexity : ℕ → ℕ} →
      (witness : ℕ → Finset ℕ) →
        (history : (i : ℕ) → Fin (complexity i) → α) →
          (∀ (i : ℕ), Function.Injective (history i)) →
            (∀ (i : ℕ),
                0 < complexity i →
                  Set.range (history i) = GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.indexedIntersection F (witness i)) →
              (∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < complexity i → i ∈ witness i) →
                (∀ (i j : ℕ), j ∈ witness i → j ≠ i → j < i) →
                  (∀ (i j : ℕ), j ∈ witness i → j ≠ i → complexity j < complexity i) →
                    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.WitnessCertificate F complexity

docstring:
Full existence part of Claim B.1: bounded natural-valued scores attain a
maximum even though the universe of possible finite witness sets need not be

name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.claim_B_1_exists_maximal_noisyWitness
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (F : ℕ → Set α) (noise : ℕ → ℕ) (scopeSet : Finset ℕ) (target maxNoise : ℕ),
  (∀ coordinate ∈ scopeSet, noise coordinate ≤ maxNoise) →
    (∃ sample, GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyProcedureSampleCandidate F noise scopeSet target sample) →
      ∃ sample,
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyProcedureSampleCandidate F noise scopeSet target sample ∧
          ∀ (other : Finset α),
            GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyProcedureSampleCandidate F noise scopeSet target other →
              other.card ≤ sample.card

docstring:
Claim B.1's displayed uniform bound for every Step-A candidate in one
finite scope.  `procedureStepComplexity` is the largest finite common-core
size in that scope, and `scopeSet.card * maxNoise` pays for all exceptions.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.claim_B_1_noisyWitness_card_bound
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {noise : ℕ → ℕ} {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} {target : ℕ} {sample : Finset α}
  {witness : Finset ℕ} {maxNoise : ℕ},
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyWitnessCandidate F noise scopeSet target sample witness →
    (∀ coordinate ∈ scopeSet, noise coordinate ≤ maxNoise) →
      sample.card ≤ GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.procedureStepComplexity F scopeSet target + scopeSet.card * maxNoise

docstring:
The exact insertion step in Claim B.3.

Suppose the old stored witness maximizes the target score in `scopeSet`.
After `newCoordinate` is inserted, its own Step-A maximum is `newScore`, and
the while-loop comparison says `newScore ≤ oldSample.card`.  Every enlarged
target candidate either omits the new coordinate, hence was covered by the
old maximum, or contains it, hence can be retargeted to `newCoordinate` and
is covered by the comparison.  Therefore the literal old witness remains an
argmax in the enlarged prefix.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.claim_B_3_maximal_noisyWitness_persists_insert
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {noise : ℕ → ℕ} {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} {target newCoordinate newScore : ℕ}
  {oldSample : Finset α} {oldWitness : Finset ℕ},
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaximalNoisyWitness F noise scopeSet target oldSample oldWitness →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise (insert newCoordinate scopeSet) newCoordinate newScore →
      newScore ≤ oldSample.card →
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaximalNoisyWitness F noise (insert newCoordinate scopeSet) target oldSample
          oldWitness

docstring:
Literal finite-stage argmax form: not only the numerical bound, but the
same stored Step-A witness remains feasible and maximal after all recorded
insertions.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.claim_B_3_maximal_noisyWitness_persists_insertions
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {noise : ℕ → ℕ} {target : ℕ} {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} {oldSample : Finset α}
  {oldWitness : Finset ℕ} (inserted : List ℕ),
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaximalNoisyWitness F noise scopeSet target oldSample oldWitness →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyInsertionComparisonBounds F noise oldSample.card scopeSet inserted →
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaximalNoisyWitness F noise (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.noisyInsertAll scopeSet inserted)
        target oldSample oldWitness

docstring:
Bound-only form of the same Claim B.3 insertion step.  This is convenient
for induction when the stored witness itself is carried separately.

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {noise : ℕ → ℕ} {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} {target newCoordinate oldBound newScore : ℕ},
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise scopeSet target oldBound →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise (insert newCoordinate scopeSet) newCoordinate newScore →
      newScore ≤ oldBound →
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise (insert newCoordinate scopeSet) target oldBound

docstring:
Finite-stage Claim B.3 invariant: iterating the exact one-insertion
argument preserves the old target's score bound through every crossing
allowed by the Procedure-2 comparator.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.claim_B_3_noisyArgmaxBound_persists_insertions
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : ℕ → Set α} {noise : ℕ → ℕ} {target oldBound : ℕ} {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} (inserted : List ℕ),
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise scopeSet target oldBound →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyInsertionComparisonBounds F noise oldBound scopeSet inserted →
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.NoisyArgmaxBound F noise (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.noisyInsertAll scopeSet inserted)
        target oldBound

docstring:
In the source procedure, language zero initially stores the empty
witness.  After the disjoint language is swapped in front of it, the
displayed feasible arg-max family is nonempty, but the stored empty witness
is infeasible.  This is a concrete counterexample to literal Claim 3.2.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.literal_claim_3_2_counterexample
type:
(∃ witness,
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.disjointInfiniteFamily {0, 1} 0
      witness) ∧
  ¬GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.disjointInfiniteFamily {0, 1} 0
      (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.procedureStepWitness GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.disjointInfiniteFamily {0} 0)

docstring:
Precise diagnostic for the literal Claim 3.2 statement.

If no candidate existed at insertion but a candidate exists in a later
scope, Procedure 1 stored the empty witness.  The later arg-max problem is
nonempty, but that stored witness is not one of its feasible points.  Hence
the paper's displayed membership in `arg max` is false in this case, even
though the max-value invariant proved above remains true.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.literal_claim_3_2_empty_witness_obstruction
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (F : ℕ → Set α) {initialScope laterScope : Finset ℕ} {target : ℕ},
  (¬∃ witness, GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F initialScope target witness) →
    (∃ witness, GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F laterScope target witness) →
      (∃ witness, GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F laterScope target witness) ∧
        ¬GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F laterScope target
            (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.procedureStepWitness F initialScope target)

docstring:
One crossing step in Claim 3.2.

An old target has a score bound in `scopeSet`.  The newly inserted language
is allowed into the old target's scope only after the new language's own
maximum in that enlarged scope was found to be no larger than the old bound.
Every genuinely new old-target candidate contains the new language and is
therefore also a candidate for it.

type:

  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaxScoreBound F scopeSet target bound →
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.procedureStepComplexity F (insert newIndex scopeSet) newIndex ≤ bound →
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaxScoreBound F (insert newIndex scopeSet) target bound

docstring:
The corrected max-value invariant iterated through a finite list of
crossings.  `scopes k` is the scope immediately before crossing `newIndices
[k]`; the two equalities make the recursion source-facing rather than
silently replacing Procedure 1 by a bulk union.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.maxScoreBound_persists_insertions
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (F : ℕ → Set α) {target bound : ℕ} (newIndices : List ℕ) (scopes : ℕ → Finset ℕ),
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaxScoreBound F (scopes 0) target bound →
    (∀ k < newIndices.length,
        scopes (k + 1) = insert (newIndices.getD k 0) (scopes k) ∧
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.procedureStepComplexity F (scopes (k + 1)) (newIndices.getD k 0) ≤ bound) →
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MaxScoreBound F (scopes newIndices.length) target bound

docstring:
The local invariant behind Claim 3.2.  If an old witness maximizes the
finite-intersection score in `prefix`, and every newly available candidate
that actually uses `newIndex` has no larger score, then the same old
witness remains an argmax after insertion.
name: GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.maximal_finiteIntersectionCandidate_persists_insert
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (F : ℕ → Set α) {scopeSet : Finset ℕ} {target newIndex : ℕ} {witness : Finset ℕ},
  GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F scopeSet target witness →
    (∀ (other : Finset ℕ),
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F scopeSet target other →
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F other ≤
            GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F witness) →
      (∀ (other : Finset ℕ),
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F (insert newIndex scopeSet) target other →
            newIndex ∈ other →
              GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F other ≤
                GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F witness) →
        GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F (insert newIndex scopeSet) target witness ∧
          ∀ (other : Finset ℕ),
            GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.FiniteIntersectionCandidate F (insert newIndex scopeSet) target other →
              GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F other ≤
                GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.finiteIntersectionScore F witness

docstring:
Overview Theorem 1, at the semantic finite-history level.

For every requested finite prefix, the recursively constructed Procedure-1
times are achieved by one non-uniform generator on the entire family, and
the achieved time vector satisfies the source's finite-prefix Pareto
comparison.

∀ {α : Type u_1} [Infinite α] (F : ℕ → Set α) (stage : ℕ),
  ∃ G time,
    GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.AchievesTimeVector G F time ∧
      GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PositiveTimeVector time ∧
        (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.MatchesPrefix stage time fun i =>
            (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.canonicalProcedureStage F stage).complexity i + 1) ∧
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.PrefixParetoOptimal stage (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.RealizableTimeVectors F) time

        (fun i j =>
          GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.setComplexity complexity target value i ≤
            GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.setComplexity complexity target value j)
        order

docstring:
Claim 3.1: improving a certified canonical coordinate forces a loss at
an earlier coordinate.

The proof presents the whole finite witness intersection.  Correctness for
the improved target forces a new output in that target but outside the
intersection.  Some earlier witness language therefore rejects the same
output, and its smaller certified complexity makes this a violation of the
claimed earlier time bound.

    (GenLimit.ParetoGeneration.RealizableTimeVectors F)

docstring:
Backtracking after round `t`'s adversary announcement falsifies the old
focus.  Criticality before the announcement is evaluated at `t`; criticality
after it is evaluated at `t + 1`.

If the old scope still contains a consistent language, the machine keeps the
highest old critical language that remains critical.  When none survives, it
uses the lowest consistent language in that scope.  If the old scope has no
consistent language, it expands to the globally lowest consistent index.

    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision C stream t old).focus

  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.consistentIndices C stream (t + 1) old.scope).Nonempty →
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.survivingCriticalIndices C stream t old.scope).Nonempty →
          (GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision C stream t old).focus < old.focus
