name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision_scope_le_focus_of_empty
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  ¬(GenLimit.PatientMachine.consistentIndices C stream (t + 1) old.scope).Nonempty →
    (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) i) →
      old.scope ≤ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision C stream t old).focus

docstring: Backtracking always increments `tau` and records its branch.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision_tau
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision C stream t old).tau = old.tau + 1

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.certifiedLanding_label_injective
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z t u i j : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u j →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.landingLabel O stream t i = GenLimit.PatientMachine.landingLabel O stream u j →
          t = u ∧ i = j

docstring:
Equal canonical labels force equality of certified landing times and
focus indices.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.certifiedLanding_label_injective_of_onModel
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u i j : ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u j →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.landingLabel O stream t i = GenLimit.PatientMachine.landingLabel O stream u j →
          t = u ∧ i = j

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.certifiedLanding_latestDeparture_injective
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z t u i j : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u j →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i = GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream u j →
          t = u ∧ i = j

docstring:
The canonical latest departure determines a certified landing's time and
focus.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.certifiedLanding_latestDeparture_injective_of_onModel
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u i j : ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u j →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i = GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream u j →
          t = u ∧ i = j

docstring: Indices that are consistent after `t` observations and lie in scope.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.consistentIndices
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ

docstring: Critical indices after `t` observations and inside the given scope.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalIndices
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ

docstring: Canonical first threshold witnessing eventual target criticality.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalStart
type: (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) → (stream : ℕ → ℕ) → (z : ℕ) → GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalStart_spec
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z)) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalStart O stream z hP ≤ t → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream t z

docstring:
In a backtracking step, every new critical language strictly below the
new focus was already critical and strictly below the old focus.  In either
least-consistent fallback branch there is no such language.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.critical_below_backtrack_was_below_old_focus
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
      (∃ j, GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) j) →
        GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i →
          i < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.backtrackDecision C stream t old).focus →
            GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i ∧ i < old.focus

docstring:
Below a surviving old critical language, new criticality is exactly old
criticality.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.critical_iff_next_below_survivor
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t b i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t b →
    GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) b →
      i ≤ b → (GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i ↔ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i)

docstring:
If the old focus survives one more observation, criticality of every
language in the old scope is unchanged.  The old focus being maximal is the
key hypothesis: every old critical language contains it and therefore also
survives.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.critical_iff_next_of_focus_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope focus : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t scope focus →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) focus →
      ∀ i < scope, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i ↔ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i

docstring:
An eventually permanent critical witness eventually enters the patient
scope and remains there.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.critical_witness_eventually_in_scope
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {E : GenLimit.Language} {w Tc : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream E →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
      (∀ (t : ℕ), Tc ≤ t → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream t w) →
        ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → w < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope

docstring: Focus update after receiving the adversary value in round `t`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → GenLimit.PatientMachine.State → GenLimit.PatientMachine.Decision

docstring:
The complete focus decision is well-formed under the abstract on-model
condition that at least one language remains consistent.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_isFocus
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) i) →
      GenLimit.IsFocus C stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).scope
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).focus

docstring: Every decision either preserves `tau` or increments it once.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_cases

docstring:
On model, `tau` stays fixed exactly when the focus stays fixed; otherwise
it increases by one.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_eq_focus_test
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) i) →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).tau =
        if (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).focus = old.focus then old.tau else old.tau + 1

docstring:
When the old focus remains consistent, an unchanged focus implies an
unchanged `tau`; this excludes the backtracking fallback.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_eq_of_focus_eq_of_consistent
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).focus = old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).tau = old.tau

docstring:
In any on-model round with at least one consistent language, retaining
the focus is equivalent, as far as the recurrence is concerned, to retaining
`tau`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_eq_of_focus_eq_of_exists_consistent
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) i) →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).focus = old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).tau = old.tau

docstring: Any decision which changes focus increments `tau` exactly once.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_eq_succ_of_focus_ne
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).focus ≠ old.focus →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).tau = old.tau + 1

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide_tau_mono
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  old.tau ≤ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide C stream t old).tau

docstring: Departure rounds from `i` strictly before time `t`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.departureTimes
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.departure_le_latest
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i d : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.departureTimes O stream t i).Nonempty →
    d < t →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d → d ≤ GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i

docstring:
Exact-presentation specialization of
`exists_later_scope_increase_below_witness`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_later_scope_increase_below_target
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {z T t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    (∀ (u : ℕ), T ≤ u → ∀ i ≤ z, GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream u i ↔ O.language z ⊆ O.language i) →
      T ≤ t →
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope ≤ z →
          ∃ u, t < u ∧ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream u).scope

docstring:
Once consistency has stabilized on indices through `w`, a scope not yet
containing `w` must later increase.  The presented set need not itself be one
of the indexed languages; `hOn` supplies the weaker on-model invariant needed
to keep the machine focus well-formed.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_later_scope_increase_below_witness
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {E : GenLimit.Language} {w T t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream E →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
      (∀ (u : ℕ), T ≤ u → ∀ i ≤ w, GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream u i ↔ E ⊆ O.language i) →
        T ≤ t →
          (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope ≤ w →
            ∃ u, t < u ∧ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream u).scope

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_upwardDeparture_between
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z a b i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    a < b →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream a).focus = i →
        i < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream b).focus →
          GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream b i →
            ∃ d, a ≤ d ∧ d < b ∧ GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d

docstring:
If a focus `i` survives until a later time at which the focus is higher,
then some intervening stable expansion departs upward from `i`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_upwardDeparture_between_of_onModel
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {a b i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    a < b →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream a).focus = i →
        i < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream b).focus →
          GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream b i →
            ∃ d, a ≤ d ∧ d < b ∧ GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d

docstring: Exact-presentation wrapper for the on-model historical theorem.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_upwardDeparture_of_critical_lt_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    ∀ (t i : ℕ),
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream t i →
        i < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus →
          ∃ d < t, GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d

docstring:
Every critical index below the current focus has an earlier upward
departure from that same index.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.exists_upwardDeparture_of_critical_lt_focus_of_onModel
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    ∀ (t i : ℕ),
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream t i →
        i < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus →
          ∃ d < t, GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d

docstring: A surviving focus remains the focus when the scope is fixed.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.focus_next_of_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope focus : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t scope focus →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) focus → GenLimit.IsFocus C stream (t + 1) scope focus

docstring:
A fresh attacker-first value is absent from the machine's used-output set
immediately before its adversary occurrence.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.fresh_attacker_not_mem_used
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {t : ℕ},
  stream t ∈ GenLimit.AdversaryFirst stream (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream) →
    stream t ∉ GenLimit.sample stream t → stream t ∉ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t - 1)).used

docstring: The concrete game trace generated by a semantic patient-scope run.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace
type:
(O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) →
  (stream : ℕ → ℕ) →
    (z validFrom : ℕ) →
      GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
        (∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z) →
          GenLimit.PatientScope.GameTrace

docstring:
The concrete machine trace satisfies the abstract comparison premise used
by `GameTrace.predecessorPartner_lt`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace_hasPredecessorComparison
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z validFrom : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (hvalid : ∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).HasPredecessorComparison
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom)

docstring:
Highest critical index in scope, with an explicit fallback for histories
outside the paper's model.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestCritical
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestCritical_isFocus
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope fallback : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalIndices C stream t scope).Nonempty →
    GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t scope (GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestCritical C stream t scope fallback)

docstring:
Highest old critical index that is still critical, again totalized by an
explicit fallback.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestSurvivor
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestSurvivor_spec
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope fallback : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.survivingCriticalIndices C stream t scope).Nonempty →
    have i := GenLimit.PatientMachine.highestSurvivor C stream t scope fallback;
    i < scope ∧
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i ∧
        GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i ∧
          ∀ j < scope, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t j → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) j → j ≤ i

docstring: The initial state, before either party has announced a value.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.initialState
type: GenLimit.PatientMachine.State

docstring: At time zero, index zero is the unique index in scope and is critical.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.initial_focus_isFocus
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ),
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream 0 GenLimit.PatientMachine.initialState.scope GenLimit.PatientMachine.initialState.focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.instDecidableEqMoveKind
type: DecidableEq GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.instReprMoveKind
type: Repr GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.instReprMoveKind.repr
type: GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind → ℕ → Format

docstring: Canonical focus-change label attached to a certified landing.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.landingLabel
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

docstring:
The switch losses counted in Lemma 3.13: their fresh adversary occurrence
is strictly after the machine's validity threshold.  Early switch losses stay
in the finite exceptional set and are not charged logarithmically.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Set ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss_subset_attacker_target
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z validFrom : ℕ} (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (hvalid : ∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom ⊆
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).attacker ∩ O.language z

docstring: Latest departure before `t`, totalized by zero when there is none.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture_lt_of_certifiedLanding_same_focus
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z t u i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    t < u →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u i →
          GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i < GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream u i

docstring:
Two successive certified landings at the same focus use strictly
increasing latest-departure rounds.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture_lt_of_certifiedLanding_same_focus_of_onModel
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    t < u →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream t i →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.CertifiedLanding O stream u i →
          GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i < GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream u i

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture_spec
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.departureTimes O stream t i).Nonempty →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i < t ∧
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i (GenLimit.PatientMachine.latestDeparture O stream t i)

docstring: Smallest value in the focus not previously announced by either party.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable
type: (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) → (∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (C i)) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable_minimal
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (hInfinite : ∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (C i)) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (used : Finset ℕ)
  (focus x : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available C stream t used focus x →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable C hInfinite stream t used focus ≤ x

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable_spec
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (hInfinite : ∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (C i)) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (used : Finset ℕ)
  (focus : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available C stream t used focus
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable C hInfinite stream t used focus)

docstring:
Lowest globally consistent language.  The fallback makes the definition
total on streams that have no consistent language in the family.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistent
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

docstring: Lowest consistent index in a nonempty finite scope.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistentInScope
type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistentInScope_spec
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope fallback : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.consistentIndices C stream t scope).Nonempty →
    have i := GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistentInScope C stream t scope fallback;
    i < scope ∧ GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i ∧ ∀ j < i, ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t j

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistent_spec
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t fallback : ℕ},
  (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i) →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistent C stream t fallback) ∧
      ∀ j < GenLimit.PatientMachine.lowestConsistent C stream t fallback, ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t j

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_consistentIndices
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope i : ℕ},
  i ∈ GenLimit.PatientMachine.consistentIndices C stream t scope ↔ i < scope ∧ GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_criticalIndices
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope i : ℕ},
  i ∈ GenLimit.PatientMachine.criticalIndices C stream t scope ↔ i < scope ∧ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_departureTimes
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i d : ℕ},
  d ∈ GenLimit.PatientMachine.departureTimes O stream t i ↔ d < t ∧ GenLimit.PatientMachine.UpwardDeparture O stream i d

docstring:
Every fresh attacker-first switch event after the validity threshold is
captured by `lateSwitchLoss`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_lateSwitchLoss_of_event
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {validFrom t : ℕ},
  validFrom < t →
    stream t ∈ GenLimit.AdversaryFirst stream (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream) →
      stream t ∉ GenLimit.sample stream t →
        GenLimit.PatientMachine.SwitchRound O stream t →
          stream t ∈ GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom

docstring: Membership in `used` is equivalent to occurrence as an earlier output.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_run_used_iff
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {t x : ℕ},
  x ∈ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used ↔ ∃ r < t, GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream r = x

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.mem_survivingCriticalIndices
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t scope i : ℕ},
  i ∈ GenLimit.PatientMachine.survivingCriticalIndices C stream t scope ↔
    i < scope ∧ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i ∧ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i

docstring:
At a fresh adversary occurrence of an attacker-first value, no earlier
machine output equals that value.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.no_output_before_fresh_attacker
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {t : ℕ},
  stream t ∈ GenLimit.AdversaryFirst stream (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream) →
    stream t ∉ GenLimit.sample stream t → ∀ r < t, GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream r ≠ stream t

docstring: An exact presentation of a family member is an on-model run.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.onModel_of_presents
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) → GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream

docstring: The generator's round-`t` announcement.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

docstring:
Every output belongs to the focus selected in its round, is absent from
the adversary sample through that round, and was not output earlier.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_available
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available O.language stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).focus
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t)

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_available_post_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available O.language stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t)

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_eq_leastAvailable
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t =
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable O.language ⋯ stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).focus

docstring: Generator outputs never repeat.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_injective
type: ∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ), Function.Injective (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream)

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_mem_round_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus

docstring:
Compatibility name for the post-round focus membership fact.  New code
uses `output_mem_round_focus`; this alias preserves audited downstream source
anchors.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_mem_run_succ_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_mem_run_used
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {s t : ℕ},
  s < t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream s ∈ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_minimal_post_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t x : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available O.language stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus x →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ≤ x

docstring: Generator announcements are pairwise distinct.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_ne_of_lt
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {s t : ℕ},
  s < t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream s ≠ GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_not_mem_prior_used
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∉ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.output_not_mem_sample
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∉ GenLimit.sample stream (t + 1)

docstring: The finite set of outputs in rounds strictly before `t`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.outputsBefore
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset ℕ

docstring:
Lower density achieved by the concrete patient-scope output on target
`O.language z`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientLowerDensity
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℝ

docstring:
Assemble all non-charging parts of Theorem 3.14 with a supplied concrete
target-relative charging certificate.  Its budget is
`log2 (prefixCount target n)`, exactly the target-count form needed before the
paper's order-preserving normalization.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate
type:
(O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) →
  (stream : ℕ → ℕ) →
    (z : ℕ) →
      (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z)) →
        GenLimit.PatientScope.TargetSwitchChargingCertificate (O.language z)
            (GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP) →
          GenLimit.PatientScope.PatientScopeCertificate

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate_switchLoss
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (Q :
    GenLimit.PatientScope.TargetSwitchChargingCertificate (O.language z)
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP)),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate O stream z hP Q).switchLoss =
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP

docstring:
The assembled certificate carries the target-aware logarithmic switch
budget supplied by `Q`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate_switch_bound
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (Q :
    GenLimit.PatientScope.TargetSwitchChargingCertificate (O.language z)
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP))
  (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientScope.prefixCount (GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate O stream z hP Q).switchLoss n ≤
    ((GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate O stream z hP Q).targetCount n).log2

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate_target
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (Q :
    GenLimit.PatientScope.TargetSwitchChargingCertificate (O.language z)
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP)),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate O stream z hP Q).target = O.language z

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate_validFrom
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (Q :
    GenLimit.PatientScope.TargetSwitchChargingCertificate (O.language z)
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledSwitchLoss O stream z hP)),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScopeCertificate O stream z hP Q).validFrom =
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.settledThreshold O stream z hP

docstring: Definition 2.1 novelty together with Theorem 3.14 for the same run.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScope_generation_and_lowerDensity
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    (∃ T,
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          T ≤ t →
            GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z ∧
              (∀ s ≤ t, stream s ≠ GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t) ∧
                ∀ s < t, GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream s ≠ GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientLowerDensity O stream z

docstring:
Operational form of Theorem 3.14.  It is uniform over the indexed family,
the target index, and every exact presentation of that target.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientScope_lowerDensity_half
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) → 1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.PatientMachine.patientLowerDensity O stream z

docstring:
Lemma 3.11: the semantic patient-scope generator eventually outputs fresh
elements of the presented target language.  Freshness and injectivity are
available separately as `output_not_mem_sample` and `output_injective`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.patient_validity
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z

docstring: Distinct ordinary attacker values have distinct predecessor partners.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.predecessorPartner_injective_machine
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z validFrom : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (hvalid : ∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z),
  Set.InjOn (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).predecessorPartner
    (GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).target
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).attacker
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom)
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).earlyAttacker)

docstring: Fact 3.12's strict order comparison for the machine partner.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.predecessorPartner_lt_machine
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z validFrom : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (hvalid : ∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z) {x : ℕ},
  x ∈
      GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).target
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).attacker
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom)
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).earlyAttacker →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).predecessorPartner x < x

docstring: The predecessor partner is a defender-first target value.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.predecessorPartner_mem_machine
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z validFrom : ℕ) (hP : GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z))
  (hvalid : ∀ (t : ℕ), validFrom ≤ t → GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t ∈ O.language z) {x : ℕ},
  x ∈
      GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).target
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).attacker
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom)
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).earlyAttacker →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).predecessorPartner x ∈
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).defender ∩
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.gameTrace O stream z validFrom hP hvalid).target

docstring: The previous-round form used by Fact 3.12.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.previous_output_le
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {t x : ℕ},
  0 < t →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.Available O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t - 1)).used
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus x →
      GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream (t - 1) ≤ x

docstring:
Thresholded version used by Theorem 3.14.  Because this round is already
late, failure to belong to `lateSwitchLoss` proves that it is not a switch.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.previous_output_lt_of_not_lateSwitch
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {validFrom t : ℕ},
  validFrom < t →
    stream t ∈ GenLimit.AdversaryFirst stream (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream) →
      stream t ∉ GenLimit.sample stream t →
        stream t ∉ GenLimit.PatientMachine.lateSwitchLoss O stream validFrom →
          GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream (t - 1) < stream t

docstring:
Execute round `t`: receive `stream t`, update the focus, and announce the
smallest fresh value in the resulting focus.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → GenLimit.PatientMachine.State → GenLimit.PatientMachine.State

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_age
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).age =
    if (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).focus = old.focus then old.age + 1 else 1

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).focus =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).focus

docstring: `processRound` preserves the focus well-formedness supplied by `decide`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_isFocus
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus O.language stream t old.scope old.focus →
    (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream (t + 1) i) →
      GenLimit.IsFocus O.language stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).scope
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_lastOutput
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).lastOutput =
    some
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable O.language ⋯ stream (t + 1) old.used
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).focus)

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_move
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).move =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).move

docstring:
If the target is critical both before and after a transition and is in
the old scope, the new scope still contains it.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_preserves_target_in_scope
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.OracleFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t z : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  z < old.scope →
    GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream t z →
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical O.language stream (t + 1) z →
        z < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).scope

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_scope
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).scope =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).scope

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).tau

docstring: A completed round either preserves `tau` or increments it once.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau_cases
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau = old.tau ∨
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau = old.tau + 1

docstring:
On the consistent-focus branch, a round which retains the focus also
retains `tau`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau_eq_of_focus_eq_of_consistent
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream (t + 1) old.focus →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).focus = old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau = old.tau

docstring:
In an on-model round with a consistent candidate somewhere in the
family, an unchanged focus implies unchanged `tau`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau_eq_of_focus_eq_of_exists_consistent
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (∃ i, GenLimit.Consistent O.language stream (t + 1) i) →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).focus = old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau = old.tau

docstring: A round which changes focus increments `tau` exactly once.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau_eq_succ_of_focus_ne
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).focus ≠ old.focus →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau = old.tau + 1

docstring: `tau` never decreases in one completed round.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_tau_mono
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  old.tau ≤ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).tau

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound_used
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t old).used =
    insert
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.leastAvailable O.language ⋯ stream (t + 1) old.used
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t old).focus)
      old.used

docstring:
A consistent index with no earlier consistent predecessor is
recursively critical.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.recursiveCritical_of_consistent_of_minimal
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i →
    (∀ j < i, ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t j) → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i

docstring: State after the first `t` complete rounds.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run
type: GenLimit.OracleFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → GenLimit.PatientMachine.State

docstring: The recorded age never exceeds the number of completed rounds.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_age_le_time
type: ∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ), (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).age ≤ t

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_age_pos_succ
type: ∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ), 0 < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).age

docstring:
Looking back fewer than `age` completed rounds reaches a post-state with
the same focus.  The indices `t - k`, for `k < age`, are exactly the last
`age` completed-round post-states, including the current state at `k = 0`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_focus_eq_of_lt_age
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t k : ℕ),
  k < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).age →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t - k)).focus = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus

docstring:
The semantic machine's focus is well-formed at every time along a target
presentation.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_focus_isFocus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      GenLimit.IsFocus O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus

docstring:
The semantic machine's focus is well-formed whenever the run is
on-model.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_focus_isFocus_of_onModel
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ},
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.OnModel O stream →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      GenLimit.IsFocus O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_scope_pos
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) → ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).scope

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1) =
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.processRound O stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_age
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).age =
    if (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus then
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).age + 1
    else 1

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_focus
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_move
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).move =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).move

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_scope
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).scope =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).scope

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_tau
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).tau =
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.decide O.language stream t (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t)).tau

docstring:
Along a genuine presentation, an unchanged focus between consecutive run
states implies unchanged `tau`.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_tau_eq_of_focus_eq
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {z t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).tau = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).tau

docstring:
A focus change between consecutive run states increments `tau` exactly
once.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_tau_eq_succ_of_focus_ne
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus ≠ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus →
    (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).tau = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).tau + 1

docstring: The used set recurrence inserts precisely the output of the new round.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_succ_used
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).used =
    insert (GenLimit.PatientMachine.output O stream t) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).used

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_tau_eq_focus_test
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (O.language z) →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).tau =
        if (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream (t + 1)).focus = (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).focus then
          (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).tau
        else (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).tau + 1

docstring: `tau` is globally monotone along the run.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_tau_mono
type:
∀ (O : GenLimit.OracleFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {s t : ℕ},
  s ≤ t → (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream s).tau ≤ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.run O stream t).tau

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.run_tau_pos

docstring:
Stable-focus update.  Once `2 ^ tau` complete rounds have elapsed under

type: GenLimit.LanguageFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → GenLimit.PatientMachine.State → GenLimit.PatientMachine.Decision

docstring:
A stable-branch focus change can only move to the newly admitted index.
It therefore certifies that the exponential waiting condition was met.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_changed
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
      (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).focus ≠ old.focus →
        2 ^ old.tau ≤ old.age ∧ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).focus = old.scope

docstring: In an expansion round the selected focus is never below the old focus.
name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_focus_le
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
      old.focus ≤ (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_isFocus
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t old.scope old.focus →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) old.focus →
      GenLimit.IsFocus C stream (t + 1) (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).scope
        (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).focus

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_move
type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),
  (GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old).move =
    if 2 ^ old.tau ≤ old.age then GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind.expand else GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind.stay

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_of_not_wait
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ} {old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State},
  ¬2 ^ old.tau ≤ old.age →
    GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision C stream t old =
      { scope := old.scope, tau := old.tau, focus := old.focus, move := GenLimit.PatientMachine.MoveKind.stay }

name: GenLimit.PatientMachine.stableDecision_scope

∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (old : GenLimit.PatientMachine.State),

docstring:

Only Fact 3.12's partner and Lemma 3.13's switch budget remain to be supplied.

  (switchLoss : Set ℕ) →
    switchLoss ⊆ G.attacker ∩ G.target →
      (partner : ℕ → ℕ) →
        (∀ x ∈ GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker G.target G.attacker switchLoss G.earlyAttacker,
            partner x ∈ G.defender ∩ G.target) →
          (∀ x ∈ GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker G.target G.attacker switchLoss G.earlyAttacker, partner x < x) →
            Set.InjOn partner (GenLimit.PatientScope.ordinaryAttacker G.target G.attacker switchLoss G.earlyAttacker) →
              (switchBudget : ℕ → ℕ) →
                (∀ (n : ℕ), GenLimit.PatientScope.prefixCount switchLoss n ≤ switchBudget n) →

docstring:
Theorem 2.16: all positive finite noise levels collapse to level one for
both uniform and non-uniform generation.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.Results.theorem_2_16
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] [Nonempty α] {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.AllLanguagesInfinite C →
    ∀ {i : ℕ},
      1 ≤ i →
        (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C i ↔
            GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C 1) ∧
          (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C i ↔
            GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C 1)

docstring:
Theorem 2.17: a class over the paper's literal universe is uniformly
generatable without noise but not non-uniformly generatable with one noisy
value.  The witness uses the full rejected-iteration scan for Algorithm 1.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.Results.theorem_2_17
type:
∃ C,
  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C 0 ∧
    ¬GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C 1

docstring:
Theorem 2.18: the three uniform noisy-generation conditions are
equivalent, and noiseless uniform generation is strictly stronger.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.Results.theorem_2_18
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] [Nonempty α] {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.AllLanguagesInfinite C →
    ((GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.FiniteNoisyClosureDimensionAt C 1 ↔
          ∀ (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C i) ∧
        (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.FiniteNoisyClosureDimensionAt C 1 ↔
          GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformNoiseDependentGeneratable C)) ∧
      ∃ D,
        GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel D 0 ∧
          ¬GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.UniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel D 1

docstring:
Theorem 2.19: the three non-uniform noisy-generation conditions are
equivalent, and noiseless non-uniform generation is strictly stronger.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.Results.theorem_2_19
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] [Nonempty α] {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.AllLanguagesInfinite C →
    ((GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.HasFiniteDimensionExhaustionAt C 1 ↔
          ∀ (i : ℕ), 1 ≤ i → GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel C i) ∧
        (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.HasFiniteDimensionExhaustionAt C 1 ↔
          GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformNoiseDependentGeneratable C)) ∧
      ∃ D,
        GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel D 0 ∧
          ¬GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformGeneratableAtNoiseLevel D 1

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {S : Finset α} {k : ℕ},

    ∃ B, (∀ (j : Fin k), (B j).card = k) ∧ (∀ (j : Fin k), B j ⊆ S) ∧ ∀ (j l : Fin k), j ≠ l → Disjoint (B j) (B l)

docstring:
If `N ⊆ S` has at most `k` points, a balanced `k × k` partition can be
chosen so that every row contains at most one point of `N`.  This is the
finite combinatorial construction used in the `k ≥ i` case of Lemma 3.2.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.exists_balanced_grid_partition_spreading
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {S N : Finset α} {k : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    N ⊆ S →
      N.card ≤ k →
        S.card = k * k →
          ∃ B,
            (∀ (j : Fin k), (B j).card = k) ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin k), B j ⊆ S) ∧
                (∀ (j l : Fin k), j ≠ l → Disjoint (B j) (B l)) ∧
                  ∀ (j : Fin k), ∀ a ∈ B j, a ∈ N → ∀ b ∈ B j, b ∈ N → a = b

docstring:
The first half of Lemma 3.2: a `k²`-point level-`i` version space
admits a balanced partition whose every row has a nonempty level-`i-1`
version space.  The proof follows the source's two cases, but chooses one
level-`i` language first and then tests whether that language already works
at level `i-1`.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.exists_balanced_partition_with_lower_version
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α} {S : Finset α} {i k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ i →
    1 ≤ k →
      S.card = k * k →
        (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.consistentLanguages C (↑S) i).Nonempty →
          ∃ B,
            (∀ (j : Fin k), (B j).card = k) ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin k), B j ⊆ S) ∧
                (∀ (j l : Fin k), j ≠ l → Disjoint (B j) (B l)) ∧
                  ∀ (j : Fin k), (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.consistentLanguages C (↑(B j)) (i - 1)).Nonempty

docstring:
Lemma 4.5.  A level-one finite-dimension exhaustion suffices for one
generator at every finite noise level.

The diagonal sufficiency theorem of Raman--Raman is applicable after
propagating the `j`th layer's level-one dimension to level `j`.  Its
generator handles the more permissive repeated-stream model, so the
`rr_nonuniform_implies_nonuniformNoiseDependent` bridge gives precisely the
paper's injective Definition 2.7.
name: GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.lemma_4_5
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Countable α] [Nonempty α] {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.AllLanguagesInfinite C →
    GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.HasFiniteDimensionExhaustionAt C 1 →
      GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NonuniformNoiseDependentGeneratable C

docstring:

docstring:

closure is already the required witness.  If all block closures are
infinite, a system of distinct representatives finishes the construction
through `squareRootWitness_of_partition_representatives`.

type:

  2 ≤ i →
    (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.consistentLanguages C (↑S) i).Nonempty →
      Set.Finite (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.noisyClosure C (↑S) i) →
        ∀ (B : Fin k → Finset α),
          (∀ (j : Fin k), (B j).card = k) →
            (∀ (j : Fin k), B j ⊆ S) →
              (∀ (j l : Fin k), j ≠ l → Disjoint (B j) (B l)) →
                (∀ (j : Fin k), (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.consistentLanguages C (↑(B j)) (i - 1)).Nonempty) →
                  GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NoisyClosureWitnessAt C (i - 1) k

docstring:
Given disjoint blocks and distinct representatives from their
level-`i-1` closures, the representative set is a size-`k` witness at level
`i-1`.  This formalizes the second half of the paper's square-root proof; the
balanced partition/representative construction is a separate obligation.

type:

      Set.Finite (GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.noisyClosure C (↑S) i) →
        ∀ (B : Fin k → Finset α),
          (∀ (j : Fin k), B j ⊆ S) →
            (∀ (j l : Fin k), j ≠ l → Disjoint (B j) (B l)) →
              ∀ (x : Fin k → α),
                Function.Injective x →
                  (∀ (j : Fin k), x j ∈ GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.noisyClosure C (↑(B j)) (i - 1)) →
                    GenLimit.QuantifyingNoise.NoisyClosureWitnessAt C (i - 1) k

type:
∀ (C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t x : ℕ),
  GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t x =
    match x with

      GenLimit.Consistent C stream t (n + 1) ∧ ∀ j ≤ n, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t j → C (n + 1) ⊆ C j

docstring:
The black-box correctness lemma used inside the replay induction.  A
positive prefix whose entries are target-valid can be completed by repeating
its first element, allowing the ordinary uniform guarantee to be applied
without assuming that the future replay stream is already valid.
name: GenLimit.Replay.ordinary_output_valid_on_valid_prefix
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Inhabited α] {gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α} {H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α} {d : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Generic.IsUniformGeneratorAt gen H d →
    ∀ {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
      L ∈ H →
        ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {threshold current : ℕ},
          threshold ≤ current →
            0 < current →
              (∀ k < current, stream k ∈ L) →
                (GenLimit.Generic.sample stream threshold).card = d → GenLimit.Generic.output gen stream current ∈ L

name: GenLimit.Replay.output_burnInGenerator_below_threshold

  {t : ℕ},
  0 < t →
    ¬d ≤ (GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t).card →
      GenLimit.Generic.output (GenLimit.Replay.burnInGenerator gen d) stream t = stream 0

name: GenLimit.Replay.output_burnInGenerator_of_threshold
type:

  {t : ℕ},
  0 < t →
    d ≤ (GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t).card →
      GenLimit.Generic.output (GenLimit.Replay.burnInGenerator gen d) stream t = GenLimit.Generic.output gen stream t

name: GenLimit.Replay.output_mem_finite_intersection
type:
∀ {gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator GenLimit.Replay.HardPoint} {d t M s : ℕ},
  M = max d t →
    M ≤ s →
      (∀ (q : ℕ),
          d ≤ q →
            GenLimit.Generic.CorrectAt gen GenLimit.Replay.upperLanguage (GenLimit.Replay.adversarialStream gen d) q) →
        (∀ (q : ℕ),
            t ≤ q →
              GenLimit.Generic.CorrectAt gen (GenLimit.Replay.cutoffLanguage d)
                (GenLimit.Replay.adversarialStream gen d) q) →
          ∃ n < d, GenLimit.Generic.output gen (GenLimit.Replay.adversarialStream gen d) s = Sum.inl n

  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.OutputsAt M Set.univ

    (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.chosenExecution M hterm mid).2

docstring:
Kernel-checked finite-transcript core of published Lemma 4.9.

Initially every target query is answered positively, while indexed group
queries are answered according to the binary partition generated by `red`.
If the decoded output gives positive mass to an unqueried point, that point is
removed from the target without changing any recorded answer.  Otherwise,
consistency puts all positive output mass on queried second-group points, so
the representation error is at least one half.

This theorem is deliberately local to one completed round.  Its conclusion
preserves the exact adaptive trace and output code.  The full companion proof
uses the same invariance principle inside a simpler target-`univ`,
finite-mass-blocking construction.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.finiteTranscript_diagonal
type:
∀ {Code : Type u_1} (M : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.Algorithm ℕ Code) (history : List ℕ)
  (red : Finset ℕ) (trace : List (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.AnsweredQuery ℕ)) (code : Code),
  history.toFinset.Nonempty →
    red ⊆ history.toFinset →
      history.toFinset.card ≤ 2 * red.card →
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.TerminatesWith M Set.univ
            (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.binaryGroups ↑red) history trace code →
          ∃ target firstGroup,
            target.Infinite ∧
              ↑history.toFinset ⊆ target ∧
                GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition
                    (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.binaryGroups firstGroup) ∧
                  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.TerminatesWith M target
                      (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.binaryGroups firstGroup) history trace code ∧
                    (¬GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.SupportedOn (M.decode code) (target \ ↑history.toFinset) ∨
                      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) ≤
                        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance (M.decode code) history.toFinset
                          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.MembershipQuery.binaryGroups firstGroup))

docstring:
Published Lemma 4.3, with the statement/proof quantifier mismatch
repaired by one alpha-independent partition.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.Published.lemma_4_3
type:
∃ groups H,
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups ∧
    Function.Injective groups ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ), (groups n).Nonempty) ∧
        Set.Finite H ∧
          Set.ncard H = 1 ∧
            GenLimit.Generic.UUS H ∧
              ¬GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.HasFiniteSupport H groups ∧
                ¬GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RepresentativelyGeneratableInLimit H groups ∧
                  ∀ (alpha : ℝ),
                    0 < alpha →
                      alpha < 1 →
                        ¬GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.AlphaRepresentativelyGeneratableInLimit H groups alpha

docstring:

closure-feasible at every nonempty sample whose cardinality is at least the
uniform threshold.  A threshold-sized subset is placed first in the
history; uniform consistency then persists until the full sample has been
shown.

            d ≤ S.card → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.ClosureFeasibleAt H groups alpha S

docstring:

paper's countable redistribution argument.  This theorem performs that
argument uniformly in the finite- and infinite-available-group cases.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.boundedMassAllocation_of_not_groupClosureConditionTwo
type:

              (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.unavailableGroups H groups S)ᶜ (ENNReal.ofReal alpha)
              (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups
                (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.unavailableGroups H groups S)))

alternative (2) of Definition 3.1.  The proof sums the coordinatewise

docstring:
A cardinality bound on all group-closure witnesses forces feasibility
strictly above that bound.  This packages the contradiction step used by
the generator in the sufficiency direction of Theorem 3.3.

    0 < alpha →

        ∀ {S : Finset α},
          S.Nonempty →
            (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.consistentHypotheses H S).Nonempty →
              d < S.card → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.ClosureFeasibleAt H groups alpha S

docstring:

distribution supported on the unseen closure.  This is the complete
countable mass-allocation step in the sufficiency proof of Theorem 3.3.

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Nonempty α] [Countable α] (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),
  Set.Countable H →
    Set.Infinite H →
      GenLimit.Generic.UUS H →
        ∀ {k : ℕ} (groups : Fin k → Set α),
          GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsFinitePartition groups →
            GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RepresentativelyNonuniformlyGeneratable H
                (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.extendFinitePartition groups) ∧
              GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RepresentativelyGeneratableInLimit H
                (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.extendFinitePartition groups)

docstring:
A countable class is the increasing union of finite prefixes, each of
which is representatively uniformly generatable for a finite partition.
Theorem 3.7 therefore gives representative non-uniform generation.  The
statement also covers empty and finite classes.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.countableClass_finitePartition_representativelyNonuniformlyGeneratable
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [Nonempty α] {H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α},
  Set.Countable H →
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (groups : Fin k → Set α),
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsFinitePartition groups →
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RepresentativelyNonuniformlyGeneratable H
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.extendFinitePartition groups)

docstring:
The noncomputable information-theoretic generator described after
published Definition 4.7.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [Nonempty α] →
    GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α → (ℕ → Set α) → ℝ → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RandomizedGenerator α

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator_consistent_of_target_candidate
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] (family : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (alpha : ℝ)
  {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {t z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCriticalAt family stream t z →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsAlphaFeasibleAt (family z) groups alpha stream t →
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsConsistentAt
        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator family groups alpha) (family z) stream t

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator_representative
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] (family : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (alpha : ℝ),
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsAlphaRepresentative
    (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator family groups alpha) groups alpha

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator_succeeds
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] (family : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (alpha : ℝ),
  GenLimit.Generic.UUS (Set.range family) →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.HasFiniteExactProfileSupport (Set.range family) groups →
      ∀ {z : ℕ} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α},
        GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream (family z) →
          0 < alpha →
            ∃ T,
              GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsConsistentFrom
                (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleLimitGenerator family groups alpha) (family z) stream
                T

docstring:
At a finite sample, choose a feasibility witness for the largest
critical feasible hypothesis.  If there is no such hypothesis, use the
exactly representative empirical distribution.  The last branch only
totalizes the empty history.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleSampleDistribution
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [Nonempty α] →
    GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α →
      (ℕ → Set α) → ℝ → Finset α → ℕ → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.DiscreteDistribution α

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleSampleDistribution_representative
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] (family : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (alpha : ℝ)
  (S : Finset α) (t : ℕ),
  S.Nonempty →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance
        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.criticalFeasibleSampleDistribution family groups alpha S t) S groups ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal alpha

docstring: Critical hypotheses in the same scope form a reverse-inclusion chain.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.critical_subset_of_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {family : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageFamily α} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {t i j : ℕ},
  i ≤ j →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCriticalAt family stream t i →
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCriticalAt family stream t j → family j ⊆ family i

docstring: The pointwise contradiction behind the failure of published Lemma 4.8.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.distance_one_le_of_consistent_identity
type:
∀ {gen : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RandomizedGenerator ℕ} {t : ℕ},
  0 < t →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsConsistentAt gen GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.tailLanguage
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration t →
      1 ≤
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.distributionAt gen GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration t)
          (GenLimit.Generic.sample GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration t)
          GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.tailGroups

{α : Type u_1} →

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantBlock_filter_range

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantBlock_finiteSupportSize_top
type:
GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.finiteSupportSize GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.tailLanguage

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantBlock_mass_zero_of_consistent

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint
type: ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint_lt_succ

docstring: The empirical group profile, embedded in `ENNReal`.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN
type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (ℕ → Set α) → ℕ → ENNReal

docstring:
The empirical mass of one group, expressed as a finite-set cardinality
in `ENNReal`.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN_eq_ncard_div
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (i : ℕ),
  S.Nonempty → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN S groups i = ↑(↑S ∩ groups i).ncard / ↑S.card

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN_eq_zero_of_not_mem_image
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α)
  (hpartition : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups) {i : ℕ},
  i ∉ Finset.image (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.partitionIndex groups hpartition) S →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN S groups i = 0

docstring:
Published Definition 2.6: empirical group probability of the distinct sample.
The paper only evaluates nonempty histories.  We totalize the empty sample at
zero and explicitly require positive history length in representativeness.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability
type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (ℕ → Set α) → ℕ → ℝ

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability_le_distance_of_consistent_dominantBlock
type:
∀ {gen : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.RandomizedGenerator ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsConsistentAt gen GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.tailLanguage
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration
      (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint (n + 1)) →
    ENNReal.ofReal
        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability
          (GenLimit.Generic.sample GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration
            (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint (n + 1)))
          GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantBlockGroups n) ≤
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance
        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.distributionAt gen GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint (n + 1)))
        (GenLimit.Generic.sample GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.identityEnumeration
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantEndpoint (n + 1)))
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.dominantBlockGroups

docstring:
The lower-coordinate counterpart of
`inducedGroupProbability_le_empirical_add_of_distance`.

type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {μ : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.DiscreteDistribution α} {groups : ℕ → Set α} {alpha : ℝ}
  {S : Finset α},
  0 ≤ alpha →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance μ S groups ≤ ENNReal.ofReal alpha →
      ∀ (i : ℕ),
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability S groups i ≤
          GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.inducedGroupProbability μ groups i + alpha

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability_nonnegative
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (i : ℕ),

A globally representative fallback generator, used to cover the empty

    groups alpha

docstring:
The empirical mass assigned to a set of group indices.  `ENNReal` makes
the countable sum total; for a partition and finite nonempty sample it agrees
with the usual finite probability sum.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices
type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (ℕ → Set α) → Set ℕ → ENNReal

docstring:
For a genuine partition, empirical mass on an arbitrary set of group
indices is the fraction of observed points whose unique group index lies in
that set.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices_eq_ncard_div
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α)
  (hpartition : GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups),
  S.Nonempty →
    ∀ (I : Set ℕ),
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups I =
        ↑(↑S ∩ GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.partitionIndex groups hpartition ⁻¹' I).ncard / ↑S.card

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices_eq_sum_of_finite
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) {I : Set ℕ} (hfinite : I.Finite),
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups I =
    ∑ i ∈ hfinite.toFinset, GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupENN S groups i

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices_le_one
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α),
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups →
    S.Nonempty → ∀ (I : Set ℕ), GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups I ≤ 1

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMass_add_compl
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (groups : ℕ → Set α),
  GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups →
    S.Nonempty →
      ∀ (I : Set ℕ),
        GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups I +
            GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalMassOnGroupIndices S groups Iᶜ =
          1

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalPointDistribution

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalPointDistribution_distance_zero
type:

      S groups =

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalPointDistribution_groupProbability
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S : Finset α) (hS : S.Nonempty) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (i : ℕ),

      (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalPointDistribution S hS) groups i =

docstring: The uniform empirical distribution on the distinct observed sample.

  (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalPointPMF S hS) x = if x ∈ S then (↑S.card)⁻¹ else 0

docstring:
The empirical distribution, totalized by a point mass on the empty
sample.

type: {α : Type u_1} → [Nonempty α] → Finset α → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.DiscreteDistribution α

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalSampleDistribution_distance_zero
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] (S : Finset α),
  S.Nonempty →
    ∀ (groups : ℕ → Set α),
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalSampleDistribution S) S groups =
        0

        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.extendFinitePartition GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.commonPadGroups) 1 =

docstring:
At the moment block `n` has just been exhausted, its empirical mass is
its block length divided by the full prefix length.

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empirical_identity_tail_zero

docstring:
Corrected published Lemma 4.8.  Under repaired finite exact-profile support, every
presentation of every UUS target is eventually feasible at every positive
tolerance.

The witness pushes the uniform empirical PMF to unseen target points.  It
preserves every coordinate for observations outside the finite exceptional
set, so its error is at most that set's vanishing empirical fraction.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.eventually_isAlphaFeasibleAt_of_finiteExactProfileSupport
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α} {groups : ℕ → Set α},
  GenLimit.Generic.UUS H →
    GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.HasFiniteExactProfileSupport H groups →
      ∀ {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
        L ∈ H →
          ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α},
            GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream L →
              ∀ {alpha : ℝ},
                0 < alpha →
                  ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsAlphaFeasibleAt L groups alpha stream t

docstring:
The points with exactly the same membership vector as `x` across all

  y ∈ GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactGroupCell groups x → ∀ (i : ℕ), y ∈ groups i ↔ x ∈ groups i

A point of the target outside the repaired finite exceptional set has an

      Set.Infinite (L ∩ GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactGroupCell groups x)

docstring: The empirical PMF pushed to fresh target representatives.
name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshDistribution
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) →
    (ℕ → Set α) →
      (S : Finset α) → Set.Infinite L → S.Nonempty → GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.DiscreteDistribution α

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshDistribution_coordinate_error_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (S : Finset α) (hL : Set.Infinite L)
  (hS : S.Nonempty),
  ↑S ⊆ L →
    ∀ (hbad : (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.finiteExactProfilePoints L groups).Finite) (i : ℕ),
      ENNReal.ofReal

              GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.empiricalGroupProbability S groups i| ≤

  (hS : S.Nonempty),
  ↑S ⊆ L →
    ∀ (hbad : (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.finiteExactProfilePoints L groups).Finite),
      GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.groupSupDistance
          (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshDistribution L groups S hL hS) S groups ≤
        ↑hbad.toFinset.card / ↑S.card

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshDistribution_supportedOn

∀ {α : Type u_1} (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (groups : ℕ → Set α) (S : Finset α) (hL : Set.Infinite L)

Move a point to an unseen target point.  If its target profile cell is

arbitrary unseen target point is used.

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshRepresentative_mem_target

name: GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.exactProfileFreshRepresentative_not_mem_sample

    ∀ {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α},
      GenLimit.Generic.StreamIn stream L →
        ∀ {t : ℕ},
          (GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t).card = d + 1 →
            GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsConsistentFrom
              (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.finiteGroupClosureGenerator H groups alpha d hpartition halpha hbound)

docstring:

representative.  The last branch merely totalizes the generator on the
empty history.

{α : Type u_1} →
  [Nonempty α] →
    (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α) →
