            GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsCountablePartition groups →

  (hbound : ∀ (S : Finset α), GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.IsGroupClosureWitness H groups alpha S → S.card ≤ d)
  (S : Finset α),

        (GenLimit.RepresentativeGeneration.finiteGroupClosureSampleDistribution H groups alpha d hpartition halpha

docstring:
Source-faithful deterministic repair of Theorem 3.1.

One fixed pair of countable indexed families of infinite languages defeats
every deterministic semantic safe identifier.  The true language is always
the same universal member.  Every possible safe difference is already
represented in the fixed candidate family, so the undefined “random
location” insertion is replaced by an explicit extensional representation
condition and no probability semantics is assumed.
name: GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.theorem_3_1_deterministic_repair
type:
(∀ (i : ℕ), Set.Infinite (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily i)) ∧
  (∀ (j : ℕ), Set.Infinite (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.harmfulFamily j)) ∧
    (∀ (j : ℕ),
        GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.DifferenceRepresented
          GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily
          (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily 0)
          (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.harmfulFamily j)) ∧
      ∀
        (M :
          GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.SafeIdentifier GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.Point),
        ∃ j,
          GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.DifferenceRepresented
              GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily
              (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily 0)
              (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.harmfulFamily j) ∧
            GenLimit.SafeGeneration.LabeledPresents (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.diagonalStream M)
                (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily 0)
                (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.harmfulFamily j) ∧
              ¬GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.SafelyIdentifiesFrom M
                  GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily
                  (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.candidateFamily 0)
                  (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.harmfulFamily j)
                  (GenLimit.SafeGeneration.SafeIdentification.diagonalStream M)

name: GenLimit.Support.MissingAtMost

name: GenLimit.Support.antitone_nat_eventually_constant
type: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ), Antitone f → ∃ M, ∀ (m : ℕ), M ≤ m → f m = f M

docstring: Boolean universal quantification over `0, ..., n - 1`.
name: GenLimit.Support.boundedAll
type: {alpha : Type u_1} → (alpha → ℕ → Bool) → alpha → ℕ → Bool

name: GenLimit.Support.boundedAll_computable
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} [inst : Primcodable alpha] {p : alpha → ℕ → Bool},

name: GenLimit.Support.boundedAll_eq_true_iff

name: GenLimit.Support.classIntersection

name: GenLimit.Support.classIntersection_eq_commonCore_empty
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),

name: GenLimit.Support.classIntersection_subset_of_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},

name: GenLimit.Support.componentOutput
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Nonempty α] → [Countable α] → Set α → Finset α → α

name: GenLimit.Support.componentOutput_of_infinite
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Nonempty α] [inst_1 : Countable α] (C : Set α) (current : Finset α) (hC : C.Infinite),
  GenLimit.Support.componentOutput C current =
    GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC (GenLimit.Support.progress C hC current)

name: GenLimit.Support.componentProgress
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Countable α] → Set α → Finset α → ℕ

name: GenLimit.Support.componentProgress_of_infinite
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (current : Finset α) (hC : C.Infinite),
  GenLimit.Support.componentProgress C current = GenLimit.Support.progress C hC current

name: GenLimit.Support.correctAt_rename_iff
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α)
  (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Generic.CorrectAt (GenLimit.Support.renameGenerator e gen) (GenLimit.Support.renameLanguage e L)
      (GenLimit.Support.renameStream e stream) t ↔
    GenLimit.Generic.CorrectAt gen L stream t

docstring: Components whose padded threshold has been reached at size `k`.
name: GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices
type: (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset ℕ

docstring: The set enumerated by a stage-by-stage output procedure at input `i`.
name: GenLimit.Support.enumeratedSet

name: GenLimit.Support.enumerationWithNoiseAtMost_mono
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α} {i j : ℕ},

    GenLimit.Support.EnumerationWithNoiseAtMost stream L i → GenLimit.Support.EnumerationWithNoiseAtMost stream L j

name: GenLimit.Support.enumeration_misses_finset
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (S : Finset α),
  ∃ k, GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC k ∉ S

docstring:
Finitely many explicitly indexed eventual properties have one common
threshold.
name: GenLimit.Support.eventually_forall_lt
type: ∀ {P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} {n : ℕ}, (∀ i < n, ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → P i t) → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ i < n, P i t

docstring:
Along an exact presentation, consistency of the finite sample with one
candidate eventually agrees with containment of the whole presented set in
that candidate.
name: GenLimit.Support.eventually_sample_subset_iff_presented_subset
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {presented candidate : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream presented →
    ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → (↑(GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t) ⊆ candidate ↔ presented ⊆ candidate)

docstring:
A fixed exact positive presentation of a nonempty language over a
countable example space.
name: GenLimit.Support.exactPresentation
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Countable α] → (L : Set α) → L.Nonempty → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α

name: GenLimit.Support.exactPresentation_presents
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (L : Set α) (hL : L.Nonempty),
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents (GenLimit.Support.exactPresentation L hL) L

docstring:
Languages of `H` appearing among the first `n + 1` values of an ambient
enumeration.
name: GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α → (ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) → ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α

name: GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass_finite
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α) (enumerate : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (n : ℕ),
  Set.Finite (GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass H enumerate n)

name: GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass_isNondecreasingCover
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α) (enumerate : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α),
  H ⊆ Set.range enumerate → GenLimit.Generic.IsNondecreasingCover H (GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass H enumerate)

name: GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass_mono
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α) (enumerate : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) {m n : ℕ},
  m ≤ n → GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass H enumerate m ⊆ GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass H enumerate n

docstring: Finitely many emitted values all occur before one common stage.
name: GenLimit.Support.finite_emissions_bounded
type:
∀ {emit : ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ} {i : ℕ} (T : Finset ℕ),
  (∀ x ∈ T, ∃ stage, emit i stage = some x) → ∃ N, ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ stage < N, emit i stage = some x

docstring:
Every finite subset of an exactly presented language is contained in all
sufficiently late samples. This is the eventual form of the generic Core
progress theorem.
name: GenLimit.Support.finite_eventually_subset_sample
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream L →
    ∀ (F : Finset α), ↑F ⊆ L → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → F ⊆ GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t

docstring:
The preceding presentation-stabilization theorem can be made uniform
over any explicitly finite prefix of a candidate family.
name: GenLimit.Support.finite_scope_eventually_sample_subset_iff_presented_subset
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (candidates : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α) {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α}
  {presented : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream presented →
    ∀ (scope : ℕ),
      ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ i < scope, ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sample stream t) ⊆ candidates i ↔ presented ⊆ candidates i

docstring: First index below `n` where `p` is true, if one exists.
name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue
type: {alpha : Type u_1} → (alpha → ℕ → Bool) → alpha → ℕ → Option ℕ

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_computable
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} [inst : Primcodable alpha] {p : alpha → ℕ → Bool},
  Computable₂ p → Computable₂ (GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p)

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_eq_none_iff
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} (p : alpha → ℕ → Bool) (a : alpha) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a n = none ↔ ∀ i < n, p a i = false

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_le_of_true
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} {p : alpha → ℕ → Bool} {a : alpha} {n i j : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a n = some j → i < n → p a i = true → j ≤ i

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_spec
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} {p : alpha → ℕ → Bool} {a : alpha} {n i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a n = some i → i < n ∧ p a i = true ∧ ∀ j < i, p a j = false

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_succ
type:
∀ {alpha : Type u_1} (p : alpha → ℕ → Bool) (a : alpha) (n : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a (n + 1) =
    match GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a n with
    | some i => some i
    | none => if p a n = true then some n else none

name: GenLimit.Support.firstTrue_zero
type: ∀ {alpha : Type u_1} (p : alpha → ℕ → Bool) (a : alpha), GenLimit.Support.firstTrue p a 0 = none

docstring: Choose a point of an infinite set outside a finite forbidden set.
name: GenLimit.Support.freshFromInfinite
type: {α : Type u_1} → (C : Set α) → C.Infinite → Finset α → α

name: GenLimit.Support.freshFromInfinite_mem
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (seen : Finset α), GenLimit.Support.freshFromInfinite C hC seen ∈ C

name: GenLimit.Support.freshFromInfinite_not_mem
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (seen : Finset α), GenLimit.Support.freshFromInfinite C hC seen ∉ seen

name: GenLimit.Support.iUnion_finitePrefixSubclass
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (H : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α) (enumerate : ℕ → GenLimit.Generic.Language α),
  H ⊆ Set.range enumerate → ⋃ n, GenLimit.Support.finitePrefixSubclass H enumerate n = H

docstring: A fixed repetition-free enumeration of an infinite countable set.
name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Countable α] → (C : Set α) → C.Infinite → ℕ → α

name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration_injective
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite),
  Function.Injective (GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC)

name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (k : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC k ∈ C

docstring: The repetition-free enumeration is an exact positive presentation.
name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration_presents
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite),
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents (GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC) C

name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration_surjective
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) {x : α},
  x ∈ C → ∃ k, GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC k = x

docstring:
A fixed equivalence between `ℕ` and an infinite subset of a countable
type.
name: GenLimit.Support.infiniteSetEquiv
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Countable α] → (C : Set α) → C.Infinite → ℕ ≃ ↑C

docstring:
The largest eligible component, with the irrelevant default `0` when no
component is eligible.
name: GenLimit.Support.largestEligible
type: (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.Support.largestEligible_mem
type:
∀ (threshold : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices threshold k).Nonempty →
    GenLimit.Support.largestEligible threshold k ∈ GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices threshold k

name: GenLimit.Support.largestEligible_threshold_le
type:
∀ (threshold : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices threshold k).Nonempty → threshold (GenLimit.Support.largestEligible threshold k) ≤ k

name: GenLimit.Support.le_largestEligible
type:
∀ (threshold : ℕ → ℕ) (k n : ℕ),
  n ∈ GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices threshold k → n ≤ GenLimit.Support.largestEligible threshold k

docstring:
Select the least member of `candidates`, or `fallback` when the candidate
set is empty.
name: GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback
type: {α : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder α] → Finset α → α → α

name: GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback_eq_min'
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {candidates : Finset α} {fallback : α} (hne : candidates.Nonempty),
  GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback candidates fallback = candidates.min' hne

name: GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback_le
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {candidates : Finset α} {fallback i : α},
  i ∈ candidates → GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback candidates fallback ≤ i

name: GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {candidates : Finset α} {fallback : α},
  candidates.Nonempty → GenLimit.Support.leastCandidateWithFallback candidates fallback ∈ candidates

docstring:
The least index whose family entry is equal to the entry at `z`.
Repeated names are allowed, and no decidable equality on the entries is
required.
name: GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex
type: {β : Type u_1} → (ℕ → β) → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex_le_self
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → β) (z : ℕ), GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex family z ≤ z

name: GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex_minimal
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → β) (z i : ℕ), family i = family z → GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex family z ≤ i

name: GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex_ne_of_lt
type:
∀ {β : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → β) (z : ℕ) {i : ℕ},
  i < GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex family z → family i ≠ family z

name: GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex_spec
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} (family : ℕ → β) (z : ℕ), family (GenLimit.Support.leastEquivalentIndex family z) = family z

docstring: Executable membership for lists of natural numbers.
name: GenLimit.Support.listContains
type: List ℕ → ℕ → Bool

name: GenLimit.Support.listContains_computable
type: Computable₂ GenLimit.Support.listContains

name: GenLimit.Support.listContains_eq_true_iff
type: ∀ (xs : List ℕ) (x : ℕ), GenLimit.Support.listContains xs x = true ↔ x ∈ xs

name: GenLimit.Support.mem_eligibleIndices_iff
type:
∀ {threshold : ℕ → ℕ} {n k : ℕ},
  n ∈ GenLimit.Support.eligibleIndices threshold k ↔ GenLimit.Support.paddedThreshold threshold n ≤ k

name: GenLimit.Support.mem_of_lt_progress
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (S : Finset α) {k : ℕ},
  k < GenLimit.Support.progress C hC S → GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC k ∈ S

name: GenLimit.Support.mem_renameLanguage_iff
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α) (x : α),
  e x ∈ GenLimit.Support.renameLanguage e L ↔ x ∈ L

name: GenLimit.Support.mem_stageContents_iff
type:
∀ {emit : ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ} {i n x : ℕ},
  x ∈ GenLimit.Support.stageContents emit i n ↔ ∃ stage < n, emit i stage = some x

name: GenLimit.Support.missingAtMost_mono
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {A B : Set α} {i j : ℕ},
  i ≤ j → GenLimit.Support.MissingAtMost A B i → GenLimit.Support.MissingAtMost A B j

name: GenLimit.Support.missingAtMost_zero_iff_subset
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (A B : Set α), GenLimit.Support.MissingAtMost A B 0 ↔ A ⊆ B

name: GenLimit.Support.output_rename
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (gen : GenLimit.Generic.Generator α) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α)
  (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Generic.output (GenLimit.Support.renameGenerator e gen) (GenLimit.Support.renameStream e stream) t =
    e (GenLimit.Generic.output gen stream t)

docstring: Pad a component threshold by its index.
name: GenLimit.Support.paddedThreshold
type: (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

docstring:
Complete a finite positive history to an exact presentation of `L`.
The proof that the history lies in `L` is intentionally an argument of the
construction, so callers cannot manufacture an invalid completion.
name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [Countable α] →
    {t : ℕ} → (xs : Fin t → α) → (L : Set α) → (∀ (i : Fin t), xs i ∈ L) → L.Nonempty → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation_agrees
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {t : ℕ} (xs : Fin t → α) (L : Set α) (hxs : ∀ (i : Fin t), xs i ∈ L)
  (hL : L.Nonempty) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < t), GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation xs L hxs hL n = xs ⟨n, hn⟩

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation_apply_of_lt
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {t : ℕ} (xs : Fin t → α) (L : Set α) (hxs : ∀ (i : Fin t), xs i ∈ L)
  (hL : L.Nonempty) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < t), GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation xs L hxs hL n = xs ⟨n, hn⟩

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation_presents
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {t : ℕ} (xs : Fin t → α) (L : Set α) (hxs : ∀ (i : Fin t), xs i ∈ L)
  (hL : L.Nonempty), GenLimit.Generic.Presents (GenLimit.Support.prefixThenPresentation xs L hxs hL) L

docstring:
Keep an ordered finite prefix, then enumerate the remaining infinite
part of the target without repetition.
name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget
type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  [Countable α] →
    {n : ℕ} →
      (xs : Fin n → α) → (L : Set α) → (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite → GenLimit.Generic.Stream α

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget_injective
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {n : ℕ} {xs : Fin n → α},
  Function.Injective xs →
    ∀ (L : Set α) (hrest : (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite),
      Function.Injective (GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget xs L hrest)

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget_prefix
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → α) (L : Set α)
  (hrest : (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite) (k : Fin n),
  GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget xs L hrest ↑k = xs k

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget_range
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {n : ℕ} {xs : Fin n → α} (L : Set α),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), xs i ∈ L) →
    ∀ (hrest : (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite),
      Set.range (GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget xs L hrest) = L

name: GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget_sample
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → α) (L : Set α)
  (hrest : (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite),
  GenLimit.Generic.sample (GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget xs L hrest) n = GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs

name: GenLimit.Support.presents_renameStream
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) {stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α} {L : GenLimit.Generic.Language α},
  GenLimit.Generic.Presents stream L →
    GenLimit.Generic.Presents (GenLimit.Support.renameStream e stream) (GenLimit.Support.renameLanguage e L)

docstring: The first enumerated point of `C` not yet present in `S`.
name: GenLimit.Support.progress
type: {α : Type u_1} → [Countable α] → (C : Set α) → C.Infinite → Finset α → ℕ

name: GenLimit.Support.progress_le_of_not_mem
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (S : Finset α) {k : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC k ∉ S → GenLimit.Support.progress C hC S ≤ k

name: GenLimit.Support.progress_spec
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] (C : Set α) (hC : C.Infinite) (S : Finset α),
  GenLimit.Support.infiniteEnumeration C hC (GenLimit.Support.progress C hC S) ∉ S

name: GenLimit.Support.range_prefixThenTarget_eq_prefix_union
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Countable α] {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → α) (L : Set α)
  (hrest : (L \ ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs)).Infinite),
  Set.range (GenLimit.Support.prefixThenTarget xs L hrest) = ↑(GenLimit.Generic.sequenceSample xs) ∪ L

name: GenLimit.Support.range_renameStream
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (stream : GenLimit.Generic.Stream α),
  Set.range (GenLimit.Support.renameStream e stream) = GenLimit.Support.renameLanguage e (Set.range stream)

name: GenLimit.Support.renameGenerator
type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → α ≃ β → GenLimit.Generic.Generator α → GenLimit.Generic.Generator β

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguage
type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → α ≃ β → GenLimit.Generic.Language α → GenLimit.Generic.Language β

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass
type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → α ≃ β → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α → GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass β

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass_apply_symm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass β),
  GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass e (GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass e.symm C) = C

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass_countable_iff
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),
  Set.Countable (GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass e C) ↔ Set.Countable C

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass_symm
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (C : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),
  GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass e.symm (GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass e C) = C

name: GenLimit.Support.renameLanguageClass_union
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (e : α ≃ β) (C D : GenLimit.Generic.LanguageClass α),

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile
type: Type

docstring:
Deterministic rate estimates underlying Appendix-D Lemmas 5--8.

Starting from the source's natural budget `floor(t H_el(t))`, the
construction supplies a superlinear prefix deadline and a vanishing prefix
rate.  The new rate is eventually no larger than the original rate, while
the generalized inverse of the prefix deadline is little-o of its budget.
This theorem does not yet build the natural budget from a raw real-valued
`H_el`, replace `prefixRate` by a nonincreasing tail envelope, or prove
discrete convexity of the composed `prefixDeadline`.  Thus it proves the
deterministic asymptotic core rather than packaging a literal Definition-2
feasible profile; those are the remaining analytic steps before the
randomized reduction.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile.appendixD_deterministic_profile_estimates
type:
∀ (P : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile),
  Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio P.budget) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ↑(P.prefixDeadline.toFun i) / ↑i) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
      Filter.Tendsto P.prefixRate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P.prefixRate t ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio P.budget t) ∧
          Filter.Tendsto (fun t => GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio (P.prefixDeadline.inverse ⋯) t / P.prefixRate t)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionRatio P.deadline P.prefixDeadline.toFun)
              Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

      Filter.Tendsto P.monotonePrefixRate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun t => GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio (P.prefixDeadline.inverse ⋯) t / P.monotonePrefixRate t)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

      Antitone H →
        (∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P.prefixRate t ≤ H t) →
          Antitone P.monotonePrefixRate ∧
            Filter.Tendsto P.monotonePrefixRate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P.monotonePrefixRate t ≤ H t) ∧

docstring:
Appendix-D's deterministic rate package, now starting from the source's
raw real antitone vanishing rate.

This reaches every rate conclusion before the separate question whether
the composed prefix deadline is discretely convex.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile.appendixD_raw_rate_monotone_prefix_estimates
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (hD : D.NatSuperlinear) (hstrict : D.EventuallyStrict) (H : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 ≤ H t) →
    Antitone H →
      Filter.Tendsto H Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        ∀ (hfeasible : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatLittleOAlongRealBudget (D.inverse ⋯) fun t => ↑t * H t),
          have P := GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile.ofRawRate D hD hstrict H hfeasible;
          Antitone P.monotonePrefixRate ∧
            Filter.Tendsto P.monotonePrefixRate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P.monotonePrefixRate t ≤ H t) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun t => GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio (P.prefixDeadline.inverse ⋯) t / P.monotonePrefixRate t)
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring:
Appendix Lemmas 5--8's deterministic rate package from a raw
real-valued rate.  The composed prefix deadline's discrete convexity and the
probabilistic black-box generator are not asserted.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Results.appendix_D_rate_core
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (hD : D.NatSuperlinear) (hstrict : D.EventuallyStrict) (H : ℕ → ℝ),
  (∀ (t : ℕ), 0 ≤ H t) →
    Antitone H →
      Filter.Tendsto H Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        ∀ (hfeasible : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatLittleOAlongRealBudget (D.inverse ⋯) fun t => ↑t * H t),
          have P := GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NaturalFeasibleProfile.ofRawRate D hD hstrict H hfeasible;
          Antitone P.monotonePrefixRate ∧
            Filter.Tendsto P.monotonePrefixRate Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
              (∀ᶠ (t : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, P.monotonePrefixRate t ≤ H t) ∧
                Filter.Tendsto
                  (fun t => GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio (P.prefixDeadline.inverse ⋯) t / P.monotonePrefixRate t)
                  Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring:
Lemma 2 / Appendix Lemma 5's pathwise analytic endgame: a vanishing
deadline-exception ratio transfers a prefix-wise lower-density bound to the
element-wise timely metric.  Constructing the full feasible-profile pair and
transferring hallucination rates remain separate obligations.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Results.lemma_2_density_endgame
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (F : ℕ → ℕ),
      Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionRatio D F) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity S R F ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerTimelyDensity S R D.toFun

docstring:

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Results.theorem_12_density_endgame
type:

  (∀ (m N : ℕ), ∃ i, N ≤ i ∧ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity S R id i) →
    1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity S R id

docstring: Appendix Theorem 12 restates the same unconditional repaired result.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Results.theorem_12_totalized_gcg
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (z : ℕ),
  GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence F.language z →
    (∀ (stream : ℕ → ℕ),
        GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) →
          (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
            1 / 2 ≤
              GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                (F.order z).enumeration id) ∧
      ∃ stream,
        GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) ∧
          (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
            GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                (F.order z).enumeration id =
              1 / 2

type:

            1 / 2 ≤

                (F.order z).enumeration id) ∧
      ∃ stream,
        GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) ∧

docstring:
The full equality wrapper with the operational turn-taking certificate
left explicit as a reusable intermediate theorem.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Results.theorem_4_totalized_gcg_eq_of_turnTaking
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) →
    GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence F.language z →
      ∀ (exceptions : ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            2 *
                (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyElements (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                    (F.order z).enumeration id i).card ≤
              i + 2 * exceptions i) →
          Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.catchupRatio exceptions) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
              GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                  (F.order z).enumeration id =
                1 / 2

docstring:
After burn-in, every canonical value is first announced by one of the two
players even when the adversary does not enumerate the active language.  If
the adversary never announces the value, the literal greedy rule takes it no
later than its canonical rank.

docstring:
Appendix-D's countable diagonal domination lemma, assembled in the
same existential form as the source.

The selected `s` is monotone, diverges, is sublinear, and eventually
dominates each member of the countable family.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.countable_diagonal_domination
type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)) →
    (∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) →
      ∃ s,
        Monotone s ∧
          Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
            GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear s ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, f m i ≤ s i

docstring:
The zero-based version of Appendix D's
`r(i) = max {j ≤ i : Dₑₗ(j) < Dₚ𝒻ₓ(i)}`.

Because target positions are zero-based in Lean, the number of exceptional
positions is the cardinality of the corresponding filtered prefix.  For a
monotone element-wise deadline those positions form an initial segment, so
this cardinality is also the cutoff used in the paper's density loss
`r(i) / i`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount
type: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

docstring:
Monotonicity makes the early-deadline exceptions an initial segment:
every position at or beyond their count meets the common prefix cutoff.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount_cutoff
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (i j : ℕ),
  j < i → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount D F i ≤ j → F i ≤ D.toFun j

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount_le
type: ∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount D F i ≤ i

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount_slowed_le
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m))
  (hmono : ∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)) (i : ℕ),
  GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount D (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline D f hf hmono).toFun i ≤
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.countableDiagonal f hf i

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionRatio_nonneg

    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.natRatio (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.countableDiagonal f hf) i

docstring:

At stage `k+1` the cutoff is beyond `(k+1)^2`, beyond the preceding cutoff,
and beyond a simultaneous `(k+1)`-scaled sublinearity threshold for the
first `k+2` functions.  Including index `k+1` is harmless and makes the
zero-based statement slightly stronger than the paper's one-based version.

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.diagonalCutoff_mono

∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)),

docstring:
Burn-in version of the same bound.

At most `2T` strings in the first `i` target positions can already be
unavailable at entry time `T` (late strings plus adversary-claimed strings).
The greedy alternation therefore credits at least
`⌊(i - 2T)/2⌋` strings, exactly the finite estimate printed in Appendix E.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.greedy_after_burnIn_bound
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {prefixSet unavailable available generated adversary : Finset α} {i T : ℕ},
  prefixSet.card = i →
    Disjoint unavailable available →
      unavailable ∪ available = prefixSet →
        unavailable.card ≤ 2 * T →
          Disjoint generated adversary →
            generated ∪ adversary = available → adversary.card ≤ generated.card + 1 → (i - 2 * T) / 2 ≤ generated.card

docstring:
The alternating-ownership inequality used in all three cases of the
Appendix-E proof.  `available` is partitioned between the generator and
adversary, and the adversary is never more than one move ahead.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.greedy_alternation_half
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {available generated adversary : Finset α},
  Disjoint generated adversary →
    generated ∪ adversary = available → adversary.card ≤ generated.card + 1 → available.card / 2 ≤ generated.card

docstring: Definition 3's instance-level lower prefix-wise density.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity
type: {α : Type u_1} → (ℕ → α) → (ℕ → α) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℝ

docstring:
The deterministic liminf endgame of Appendix-D Lemma 5.

Once the deadline construction supplies `r(i) / i → 0`, the prefix-wise
lower density cannot exceed the original element-wise lower density.  This
theorem isolates exactly the analytic conclusion; constructing the slowed
deadline and proving its exception ratio vanishes remain the paper's
countable-diagonal step.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity_le_lowerTimelyDensity_of_exceptionRatio
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (F : ℕ → ℕ),
      Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionRatio D F) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity S R F ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerTimelyDensity S R D.toFun

docstring:
Density-only consequence of Appendix-D Lemmas 5--7 under an externally
supplied countable monotone sublinear family.

For the prefix deadline obtained from the actual countable diagonal, the
prefix-wise lower density is bounded by the original element-wise lower
density.  Thus the earlier reduction no longer assumes the vanishing
exception ratio as an external hypothesis.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity_slowed_le_lowerTimelyDensity
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m))
      (hmono : ∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)),
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerPrefixWiseDensity S R (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline D f hf hmono).toFun ≤
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.lowerTimelyDensity S R D.toFun

docstring:
Instance-level lower timely density.  The paper then infimizes this
quantity over targets, enumerations, and countable collections.

∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →

      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity S R F i ≤

type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ), 0 ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity S R F i

docstring:
Appendix-D Lemma 5 with the source-defined exception count rather than
an abstract cutoff hypothesis.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity_sub_deadlineException_le_timelyDensity
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (F : ℕ → ℕ) {i : ℕ},
      0 < i →
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity S R F i - ↑(GenLimit.TimeSensitive.deadlineExceptionCount D F i) / ↑i ≤
          GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity S R D.toFun i

docstring:
Ratio form printed in Appendix D.1:
`μ_i ≥ μ_i^pfx - r(i)/i`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity_sub_exception_le_timelyDensity
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D F : ℕ → ℕ) {i r : ℕ},
      0 < i →
        (∀ j < i, r ≤ j → F i ≤ D j) →
          GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseDensity S R F i - ↑r / ↑i ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity S R D i

docstring:

`F i`, rather than the individual cutoff `D j`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements
type: {α : Type u_1} → (ℕ → α) → (ℕ → α) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset α

docstring:
Exact finite-prefix core of Appendix-D Lemma 5.

If at most the first `r` target positions have a deadline earlier than the
common prefix cutoff `F i`, then every prefix-wise credited string except
possibly those `r` strings is element-wise timely.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements_subset_timely_union_early
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α) (D F : ℕ → ℕ) (i r : ℕ),
  (∀ j < i, r ≤ j → F i ≤ D j) →
    ∀ x ∈ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements S R F i,
      x ∈ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyElements S R D i ∨ x ∈ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.targetPrefix R r

docstring:
Cardinal form of the finite-prefix reduction:
`prefix-credit ≤ element-credit + r`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWise_card_le_timely_card_add
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  Function.Injective R →
    ∀ (D F : ℕ → ℕ) (i r : ℕ),
      (∀ j < i, r ≤ j → F i ≤ D j) →
        (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements S R F i).card ≤
          (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyElements S R D i).card + r

docstring:

consistent output sequence.

type:

  (∀ (k : ℕ), T ≤ k → S k ∈ L) →
    (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements S R (fun x => t) i).card ≤
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.targetIntersectionCount R L i + T

docstring:

Every credited string in the first `i` target positions is either already in
the intermediate language `L`, or is a distinct output outside `L`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefix_credit_le_target_intersection_add_hallucinations

∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α) (L : Set α) (i t : ℕ),
  (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.prefixWiseElements S R (fun x => t) i).card ≤
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.targetIntersectionCount R L i + GenLimit.TimeSensitive.hallucinationCount S L t

∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (hD : D.NatSuperlinear),
  Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowDeadlineWitness D hD) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

docstring:
Prefix deadline obtained by slowing an element-wise deadline along the
countable diagonal.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline
type:
GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline →
  (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) →
    (∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)) → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline

docstring:
Slowing an unbounded deadline along the diverging diagonal preserves
unboundedness, so the generalized inverse of the new deadline is defined.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline_isUnbounded
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline),
  D.IsUnbounded →
    ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) (hmono : ∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)),
      (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline D f hf hmono).IsUnbounded

docstring:
The source's superlinearity step in Lemma 7.

If one member `f m` of the diagonal family already makes
`D (f m i) / i` diverge, then the slowed deadline `D (s i)` is
superlinear because the diagonal eventually dominates that member.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline_superlinear_of_member
type:
∀ (D : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.Deadline) (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m))
  (hmono : ∀ (m : ℕ), Monotone (f m)) (m : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ↑(D.toFun (f m i)) / ↑i) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ↑((GenLimit.TimeSensitive.slowedDeadline D f hf hmono).toFun i) / ↑i) Filter.atTop
      Filter.atTop

docstring:
Exact finite bound for a stable greedy stage.  The explicit `4T + 3`
term accounts for the partition boundary, early canonical ranks, early
adversary announcements, and early generator outputs.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.stableGreedy_card_bound
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage} {adversary generator : ℕ → ℕ} {T i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.FreshPlay adversary generator →
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.GreedyFrom O adversary generator T →
      i ≤ 2 * (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyElements generator O.enumeration id i).card + (4 * T + 3)

docstring:
A stable literal greedy stage eventually crosses every GCG threshold.
This is the rank-aware, machine-ready form of Appendix E's finite ownership
argument.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.stableGreedy_eventually_crosses_threshold
type:
∀ {O : GenLimit.KleinbergWei.OrderedLanguage} {adversary generator : ℕ → ℕ} {T m : ℕ},
  GenLimit.FreshPlay adversary generator →
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.GreedyFrom O adversary generator T →
      ∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity generator O.enumeration id i

docstring:
If the same stage continues indefinitely, any threshold below one half
is crossed once the printed finite greedy bound crosses it.  This packages
the last implication in the stage-termination argument without introducing
the unformalized `GCG` state machine.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.stage_crosses_threshold_of_greedy_bound
type:
∀ {m i T credited : ℕ},
  (i - 2 * T) / 2 ≤ credited →
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ ↑((i - 2 * T) / 2) / ↑i →
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ ↑credited / ↑i

docstring:
Deterministic stage-termination endgame from Appendix E.

If a continuing stage satisfies the printed greedy cardinality bound
eventually, then its credited ratio eventually reaches the stage threshold.
The connection to the concrete repaired state machine is proved in
`TotalizedGCGProgress`; no runtime-complexity claim is made here.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.stage_eventually_crosses_threshold
type:
∀ (m T : ℕ) (credited : ℕ → ℕ),
  (∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, (i - 2 * T) / 2 ≤ credited i) →
    ∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ ↑(credited i) / ↑i

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.strictCritical_iff_of_eqOn_prefix
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream₁ stream₂ : ℕ → ℕ} {t i : ℕ},
  (∀ n < t, stream₁ n = stream₂ n) →
    (GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.StrictCritical C stream₁ t i ↔
      GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.StrictCritical C stream₂ t i)

docstring:
A chosen threshold for the `(q+1)`-scaled sublinearity estimate of the

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sublinearThreshold
type: (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) → (∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sublinearThreshold_le_diagonalCutoff
type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) {m k : ℕ},

    0 < k → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sublinearThreshold f hf m (k - 1) ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.diagonalCutoff f hf k

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sublinearThreshold_spec
type:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.TimeSensitive.NatSublinear (f m)) (m q i : ℕ),
  GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sublinearThreshold f hf m q ≤ i → (q + 1) * f m i ≤ i

Number of the first `i` target strings lying in an intermediate

docstring:
Restricting the preceding coverage to a finite canonical prefix leaves
only the first `T + 1` ranks as an explicit exception set.

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.targetPrefix_card_ordered

Every target point not generated by the repaired GCG must occur on an

docstring:
A cofinal family of GCG threshold checkpoints gives timely upper density
at least one half under the identity deadline.

This packages the final analytic implication in Theorems 4/12 without hiding
the state-machine invariant in an existential wrapper.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.theorem_4_density_endgame
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  (∀ (m : ℕ),
      ∃ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity S R id i) →
    1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity S R id

docstring:
Equivalent explicit-cofinality interface for the same endgame.  This is
often the most convenient form for a concrete GCG run: after any requested
time `N`, provide a later checkpoint for stage `m`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.theorem_4_density_endgame_of_cofinal_checkpoints
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (S R : ℕ → α),
  (∀ (m N : ℕ), ∃ i, N ≤ i ∧ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity S R id i) →
    1 / 2 ≤ GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity S R id

docstring: Finite element-wise timely density.  The empty prefix is assigned zero.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity_le_one

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity_nonneg

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity_outputHistory_totalized

    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream) R id n

docstring:
Definition 1.1's timely credited target strings: `R j` is credited only
when it occurs in the output prefix cut off by its own deadline `D j`.

docstring:
Element-wise credit is contained in prefix-wise credit at the current

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput
type: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput_eq_onTimeUnused_of_stage_eq
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {m t : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream t).stage = m →
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t =
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.onTimeUnused (F.order (F.guess stream (m + 1)))
        (GenLimit.sample stream (t + 1) ∪
          GenLimit.TimeSensitive.sequencePrefix (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream) t)
        t

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput_mem_active

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput_not_mem_observed
type:

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput_not_mem_prior

∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_outputs_length

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_stage_le_time

∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ),

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_stage_mono
type:

type:

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_stage_succ_of_crossed
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {m t : ℕ},

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_succ
type:

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun_zero

docstring:
One round of the repaired queue.  At round `t`, stage `m` has a next
queued guess exactly when `m < t`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGStep
type:
GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily →
  (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.TotalizedGCGState → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.TotalizedGCGState

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGStep_eq_of_eqOn_prefix
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) {stream₁ stream₂ : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ}
  {state : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.TotalizedGCGState},
  state.stage ≤ t →
    (∀ n < t + 1, stream₁ n = stream₂ n) →
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGStep F stream₁ t state =
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGStep F stream₂ t state

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_crossed_of_stage_succ
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {m t : ℕ},
  (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream t).stage = m →
    (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream (t + 1)).stage = m + 1 →
      GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold (m + 1) ≤
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
          (F.order (F.guess stream (m + 1))).enumeration id (t + 1)

docstring:
P07's eventual index validity and unbounded queue progress imply that
all sufficiently late repaired-GCG outputs lie in the target language.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_eventually_consistent

∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ),

docstring:
Every queued stage has a concrete transition round and a certified
threshold checkpoint.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_exists_stage_transition
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ),

    (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream t).stage = m ∧

          GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
            (F.order (F.guess stream (m + 1))).enumeration id (t + 1)

name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_freshPlay
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ),
  GenLimit.FreshPlay stream (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)

docstring:
Once the concrete stage is fixed at `m`, the output sequence literally
satisfies the stable greedy contract for the queued guess `m + 1`.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_greedyFrom_of_stage_constant
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) {m T : ℕ},
  (∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream t).stage = m) →
    GenLimit.TimeSensitive.GreedyFrom (F.order (F.guess stream (m + 1))) stream

docstring:
Every finite queue stage is eventually reached and never left behind.
This is the concrete termination invariant omitted from the printed proof.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_stage_eventually_ge
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (m : ℕ),
  ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → m ≤ (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGRun F stream t).stage

docstring:
Infinitely-often accurate queued guesses yield cofinal density
checkpoints for the true target order.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_target_cofinal_checkpoints
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ),
  (∀ (q : ℕ), ∃ r, q ≤ r ∧ GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.AccurateAt F.language stream z r) →
    ∀ (m N : ℕ),
      ∃ i,
        N ≤ i ∧
          GenLimit.TimeSensitive.gcgThreshold m ≤
            GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
              (F.order z).enumeration id i

docstring:
Repaired, unconditional Theorem 4 / Appendix Theorem 12 at the explicit
indexed-family interface.

The first conjunct is the constructive guarantee on every exact
presentation.  The second gives a concrete adaptive exact presentation at
which equality is attained.  Together they state that the repaired GCG is
eventually consistent and has worst-case instance-level timely upper density
exactly `1/2`; no turn-taking certificate remains as a premise.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_theorem_4
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (z : ℕ),
  GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence F.language z →
    (∀ (stream : ℕ → ℕ),
        GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) →
          (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
            1 / 2 ≤
              GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                (F.order z).enumeration id) ∧
      ∃ stream,
        GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) ∧
          (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
            GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                (F.order z).enumeration id =
              1 / 2

docstring:
The concrete sparse adaptive presentation realizes the upper endpoint,
so the repaired GCG has exact instance-level timely upper density `1/2` on
this exact presentation.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_theorem_4_adaptive_witness
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (z : ℕ),
  GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence F.language z →
    GenLimit.Presents (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.adaptivePresentation F (F.order z)) (F.language z) ∧
      (∃ T,
          ∀ (t : ℕ),
            T ≤ t →
              GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.adaptivePresentation F (F.order z))
                  t ∈
                F.language z) ∧
        GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity
            (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.adaptivePresentation F (F.order z)))
            (F.order z).enumeration id =
          1 / 2

docstring:
Exact equality once an operational Kleinberg--Wei adversary has supplied
the finite turn-taking bounds and a vanishing catch-up budget.  Keeping these
premises visible prevents the source's omitted optimality argument from being
mistaken for a consequence of the constructive lower bound.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCG_theorem_4_eq_of_turnTaking
type:
∀ (F : GenLimit.TimeSensitive.CanonicallyOrderedFamily) (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ),
  GenLimit.Presents stream (F.language z) →
    GenLimit.KleinbergWei.DensityMeasures.FirstOccurrence F.language z →
      ∀ (exceptions : ℕ → ℕ),
        (∀ᶠ (i : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
            2 *
                (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.timelyElements (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                    (F.order z).enumeration id i).card ≤
              i + 2 * exceptions i) →
          Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.catchupRatio exceptions) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
            (∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream t ∈ F.language z) ∧
              GenLimit.TimeSensitive.upperTimelyDensity (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.totalizedGCGOutput F stream)
                  (F.order z).enumeration id =
                1 / 2

docstring: Compatibility alias for the shared finite turn-taking pairing theorem.
name: GenLimit.TimeSensitive.turnTaking_finite_upper_bound
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {prefixSet credited paired exceptions : Finset α} (partner : α → α) {i e : ℕ},
  prefixSet.card = i →
    credited ⊆ prefixSet →
      credited ⊆ paired ∪ exceptions →
        paired ⊆ credited →
          exceptions.card ≤ e →
            (∀ x ∈ paired, partner x ∈ prefixSet) →
              (∀ x ∈ paired, partner x ∉ credited) → Set.InjOn partner ↑paired → 2 * credited.card ≤ i + 2 * e

    Filter.Tendsto (GenLimit.TimeSensitive.catchupRatio exceptions) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →

docstring:

prefix and there are at most `e` exceptional credits, then credits occupy at

type:

docstring:
The exact increasing diagonal stream from Proposition A.1, shifted to
the repository convention where output at time `t` sees the `t` values with
indices strictly below `t`.
name: GenLimit.UnionClosedness.deterministicDiagonalStream
type: GenLimit.Generic.Generator ℕ → ℕ → ℕ

name: GenLimit.UnionClosedness.deterministicDiagonalStream.eq_def
type:
∀ (G : GenLimit.Generic.Generator ℕ) (x : ℕ),
  GenLimit.UnionClosedness.deterministicDiagonalStream G x =
    match x with
    | 0 => 0
    | t.succ =>
      max (G (t + 1) fun i => GenLimit.UnionClosedness.deterministicDiagonalStream G ↑i)
          (GenLimit.UnionClosedness.deterministicDiagonalStream G t) +
        1

docstring:
Lemma 3.13 in integer form: the number of certified losses in a prefix of
size `n` is at most the base-two natural logarithm of `n`.
name: GenLimit.charging_card_le_log_two
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (losses : Finset α) (τ : α → ℕ) (charge : α → Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, 0 < τ ℓ) →
    Set.InjOn τ ↑losses →
      (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, 2 ^ τ ℓ ≤ (charge ℓ).card) →
        (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, charge ℓ ⊆ Finset.range n) → 0 < n → losses.card ≤ Nat.log 2 n

docstring:
The exponential form of the charging lemma.  Pairwise disjointness of the
charge sets is not required.
name: GenLimit.charging_pow_le_prefix
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (losses : Finset α) (τ : α → ℕ) (charge : α → Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ),
  (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, 0 < τ ℓ) →
    Set.InjOn τ ↑losses →
      (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, 2 ^ τ ℓ ≤ (charge ℓ).card) →
        (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, charge ℓ ⊆ Finset.range n) → 0 < n → 2 ^ losses.card ≤ n

docstring: A candidate containing the presented set is consistent at every time.
name: GenLimit.consistent_of_presented_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {E : GenLimit.Language} {i t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream E → E ⊆ C i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

docstring:
Any candidate containing the presented target is consistent at every
time.
name: GenLimit.consistent_of_target_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z i t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → C z ⊆ C i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

docstring:
Consistency is antitone in time: a candidate consistent with a later
sample was consistent with every earlier sample.
name: GenLimit.consistent_of_time_le
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u i : ℕ},
  t ≤ u → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

name: GenLimit.critical_finitelyCritical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Critical C stream t n → ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m n

docstring: The stronger #01 notion of criticality implies #39 recursive criticality.
name: GenLimit.critical_recursiveCritical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Critical C stream t n → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t n

docstring: KM-critical languages form a descending inclusion chain.
name: GenLimit.critical_subset_of_le
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i j : ℕ},
  i ≤ j → GenLimit.Critical C stream t i → GenLimit.Critical C stream t j → C j ⊆ C i

name: GenLimit.eventually_mem_sample_of_presents
type:
∀ {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {L : GenLimit.Language},
  GenLimit.Presents stream L → ∀ {u : ℕ}, u ∈ L → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → u ∈ GenLimit.sample stream t

docstring:
A fixed candidate not containing the presented set is eventually
inconsistent.
name: GenLimit.eventually_not_consistent_of_not_presented_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {E : GenLimit.Language} {i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream E → ¬E ⊆ C i → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

name: GenLimit.eventually_not_consistent_of_not_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → ¬C z ⊆ C i → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i

docstring:
A finite injective family of positive natural-number labels contains a
label at least as large as the cardinality of the family.
name: GenLimit.exists_card_le_of_injOn_pos
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (losses : Finset α) (τ : α → ℕ),
  (∀ ℓ ∈ losses, 0 < τ ℓ) → Set.InjOn τ ↑losses → losses.Nonempty → ∃ ℓ ∈ losses, losses.card ≤ τ ℓ

docstring: A focus exists whenever a critical language lies inside the scope.
name: GenLimit.exists_focus_of_critical_in_scope
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t s z : ℕ},
  z < s → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t z → ∃ f, GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f

docstring:
Once finite-scope consistency has stabilized, any candidate which is
consistent at one time stays consistent at every later time.
name: GenLimit.finite_scope_eventually_consistency_persistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) →
    ∀ (s : ℕ),
      ∃ T,
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          T ≤ t → ∀ (u : ℕ), t ≤ u → ∀ i < s, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i

docstring: Uniform stabilization of consistency on a finite index prefix.
name: GenLimit.finite_scope_eventually_consistent_iff_presented_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {E : GenLimit.Language},
  GenLimit.Presents stream E → ∀ (s : ℕ), ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ i < s, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i ↔ E ⊆ C i

docstring:
Uniform finite-scope stabilization.  The scope `s` contains the indices
`i < s`; after one threshold, each such candidate is consistent exactly when
it contains the presented target.
name: GenLimit.finite_scope_eventually_consistent_iff_target_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) →
    ∀ (s : ℕ), ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ i < s, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i ↔ C z ⊆ C i

docstring: Equation (5.4), with a non-strict cutoff comparison.
name: GenLimit.finitelyCritical_cutoff_mono
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t m m' n : ℕ},
  m' ≤ m → GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m n → GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m' n

docstring: Equation (5.3): later finite-critical candidates have smaller prefixes.
name: GenLimit.finitelyCritical_prefix_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t m i j : ℕ},
  i ≤ j →
    GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m i → GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m j → ∀ u < m, u ∈ C j → u ∈ C i

docstring:
Exact presentations of the normalized target `Set.univ` satisfy the
surjectivity premise of the first-announcement partition.
name: GenLimit.first_announcement_partition_of_presents_univ
type:
∀ {adversary generator : ℕ → ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents adversary Set.univ →
    GenLimit.AdversaryFirst adversary generator ∪ GenLimit.GeneratorFirst adversary generator = Set.univ

docstring:
One-step fixed-scope invariant.  If the announcement arriving between
times `t` and `t + 1` does not falsify the old focus, then every critical
status in the scope and the focus itself are unchanged.
name: GenLimit.fixed_scope_one_step
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t s f : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f →
    GenLimit.Consistent C stream (t + 1) f →
      (∀ i < s, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream (t + 1) i ↔ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i) ∧
        GenLimit.IsFocus C stream (t + 1) s f

docstring:
If a recursively critical index `z` lies inside the scope, the focus
language is contained in `C z`.  In the validity proof, `z` is instantiated
with the target index.  This is the set-theoretic step used in Lemma 3.11.
name: GenLimit.focus_subset_target
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t s f z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f → z < s → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t z → C f ⊆ C z

docstring:
The named-presented-set formulation of an infinite partial presentation
for the `ℕ`-universe API.
name: GenLimit.infinitePartialPresentation_iff_exists_presented_subset
type:
∀ (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (K : GenLimit.Language),
  GenLimit.InfinitePartialPresentation stream K ↔ ∃ E, GenLimit.Presents stream E ∧ Set.Infinite E ∧ E ⊆ K

docstring:
With a fixed scope, a focus which remains consistent is still the focus at
every later time.
name: GenLimit.isFocus_of_consistent_at_later_time
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u s f : ℕ},
  t ≤ u → GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u f → GenLimit.IsFocus C stream u s f

docstring: A fixed finite scope has at most one highest-indexed critical language.
name: GenLimit.isFocus_unique
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t s f g : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f → GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s g → f = g

docstring:
Adapt a learner written against a length-indexed finite tuple to the
shared ordered-list history interface.
name: GenLimit.learnerOfFiniteHistory
type: {Info : Type u_1} → {Name : Type u_2} → ((t : ℕ) → (Fin t → Info) → Name) → GenLimit.Learner Info Name

name: GenLimit.learnerOfFiniteHistory_ofFn
type:
∀ {Info : Type u_1} {Name : Type u_2} (learner : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → Info) → Name) {t : ℕ} (xs : Fin t → Info),
  GenLimit.learnerOfFiniteHistory learner (List.ofFn xs) = learner t xs

name: GenLimit.learnerOfFiniteHistory_textPrefix
type:
∀ {Info : Type u_1} {Name : Type u_2} (learner : (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → Info) → Name) (stream : ℕ → Info) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.learnerOfFiniteHistory learner (GenLimit.textPrefix stream t) = learner t fun i => stream ↑i

docstring: The least consistent candidate is KM-critical.
name: GenLimit.least_consistent_critical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Consistent C stream t n → (∀ i < n, ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i) → GenLimit.Critical C stream t n

docstring: The least consistent candidate is finite-critical at every cutoff.
name: GenLimit.least_consistent_finitelyCritical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Consistent C stream t n →
    (∀ i < n, ¬GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i) → ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m n

name: GenLimit.liminf_le_liminf_of_eventually_le_add_tendsto_zero
type:
∀ {u v error : ℕ → ℝ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ u n) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), u n ≤ 1) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), v n ≤ 1) →
        (∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, u n ≤ v n + error n) →
          Filter.Tendsto error Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.liminf u Filter.atTop ≤ Filter.liminf v Filter.atTop

docstring:
The asymptotic counting core of Theorem 3.14.

`D n` and `A n` are the numbers among the first `n` target elements first
announced by the generator and adversary, respectively. The first assumption
says these two classes partition every prefix. The second is the charging
bound obtained from Fact 3.12 and Lemma 3.13.
name: GenLimit.lowerDensity_half_of_counting
type:
∀ (D A : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), D n + A n = n) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), A n ≤ D n + r + n.log2) → 1 / 2 ≤ Filter.liminf (fun n => ↑(D n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop

name: GenLimit.mem_language_of_mem_sample_of_presents
type:
∀ {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {L : GenLimit.Language},
  GenLimit.Presents stream L → ∀ {t u : ℕ}, u ∈ GenLimit.sample stream t → u ∈ L

name: GenLimit.mem_sample_iff
type: ∀ {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u : ℕ}, u ∈ GenLimit.sample stream t ↔ ∃ s < t, stream s = u

name: GenLimit.mem_textPrefix_iff
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {stream : ℕ → α} {t : ℕ} {x : α}, x ∈ GenLimit.textPrefix stream t ↔ ∃ s < t, stream s = x

docstring:
If a later-indexed old critical language remains consistent, then every
earlier old critical language remains consistent as well.  This is the local
descending-chain argument behind the patient-scope focus invariant.

No ordering assumption on `t` and `u` is needed: the conclusion follows just
from the static inclusion `C f ⊆ C i` and consistency of `f` at `u`.
name: GenLimit.old_critical_consistent_of_later_critical_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u i f : ℕ},
  i ≤ f →
    GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i →
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t f → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u f → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i

docstring:
If the old focus remains consistent, all old critical languages in its
fixed scope remain consistent.
name: GenLimit.old_critical_in_scope_consistent_of_focus_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u s f i : ℕ},
  GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f →
    i < s →
      GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u f → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i

name: GenLimit.presents_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z t : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → GenLimit.Consistent C stream t z

docstring:
Every value ever announced by the adversary has a first-announcing
party, even when the adversary does not enumerate the whole universe.
name: GenLimit.range_subset_first_announcements
type:
∀ (adversary generator : ℕ → ℕ),
  Set.range adversary ⊆ GenLimit.AdversaryFirst adversary generator ∪ GenLimit.GeneratorFirst adversary generator

name: GenLimit.recursiveCritical_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t n : ℕ},
  GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t n → GenLimit.Consistent C stream t n

docstring:
Stability of every critical status in a fixed scope when its old focus
remains consistent.  This version permits any later time `u`, not only the
next round.
name: GenLimit.recursiveCritical_iff_of_focus_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u s f : ℕ},
  t ≤ u →
    GenLimit.IsFocus C stream t s f →
      GenLimit.Consistent C stream u f →
        ∀ i < s, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream u i ↔ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i

docstring:
If every old critical language in a finite scope remains consistent at a
later time, recursive criticality is unchanged throughout that scope.

This lemma isolates the induction on Definition 3.2.  The patient-scope
application below derives `hkeep` from consistency of the old focus.
name: GenLimit.recursiveCritical_iff_of_old_critical_consistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t u s : ℕ},
  t ≤ u →
    (∀ i < s, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i) →
      ∀ i < s, GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream u i ↔ GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i

docstring: The critical languages form a descending inclusion chain (Remark 3.3).
name: GenLimit.recursiveCritical_subset_of_le
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {t i j : ℕ},
  i ≤ j → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t i → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t j → C j ⊆ C i

docstring: The set of observations strictly before time `t`.
name: GenLimit.sample
type: (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset ℕ

docstring: Samples depend only on the corresponding finite stream prefix.
name: GenLimit.sample_eq_of_eq_on_prefix
type:
∀ {stream₁ stream₂ : ℕ → ℕ} {t : ℕ},
  (∀ n < t, stream₁ n = stream₂ n) → GenLimit.sample stream₁ t = GenLimit.sample stream₂ t

name: GenLimit.sample_mono
type: ∀ {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {s t : ℕ}, s ≤ t → GenLimit.sample stream s ⊆ GenLimit.sample stream t

docstring:
The target language is eventually critical. This is the semantic core of
equation (5.2).
name: GenLimit.target_eventually_critical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.Critical C stream t z

docstring: Equation (5.2): the target is eventually finite-critical at every cutoff.
name: GenLimit.target_eventually_finitelyCritical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ (m : ℕ), GenLimit.FinitelyCritical C stream t m z

docstring:
Lemma 3.4.  Once consistency in the target prefix has stabilized, every
earlier recursively critical language is consistent and hence contains the
target.
name: GenLimit.target_eventually_recursiveCritical
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → GenLimit.RecursiveCritical C stream t z

docstring:
After one finite threshold, any consistent candidate of index at most
`z` remains consistent at all later times.
name: GenLimit.target_prefix_eventually_consistency_persistent
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) →
    ∃ T,
      ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ (u : ℕ), t ≤ u → ∀ i ≤ z, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i → GenLimit.Consistent C stream u i

docstring:
The stabilization statement requested for all candidates no later than
the target index.
name: GenLimit.target_prefix_eventually_consistent_iff_target_subset
type:
∀ {C : GenLimit.LanguageFamily} {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {z : ℕ},
  GenLimit.Presents stream (C z) → ∃ T, ∀ (t : ℕ), T ≤ t → ∀ i ≤ z, GenLimit.Consistent C stream t i ↔ C z ⊆ C i

docstring: A fixed constant plus `log₂ n` is negligible compared with `n`.
name: GenLimit.tendsto_countingError_div
type: ∀ (r : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(r + n.log2) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring: The lower comparison sequence used in Theorem 3.14 tends to `1/2`.
name: GenLimit.tendsto_half_sub_countingError
type: ∀ (r : ℕ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => 1 / 2 - ↑(r + n.log2) / (2 * ↑n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / 2))

docstring: The discrete base-two logarithm is negligible compared with `n`.
name: GenLimit.tendsto_natLog2_div
type: Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n.log2 / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

docstring: The ordered observations strictly before time `t`.
name: GenLimit.textPrefix
type: {α : Type u_1} → (ℕ → α) → ℕ → List α

docstring:
The list prefix is the list representation of the corresponding finite
tuple.
name: GenLimit.textPrefix_eq_ofFn
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : ℕ → α) (t : ℕ), GenLimit.textPrefix stream t = List.ofFn fun i => stream ↑i

name: GenLimit.textPrefix_length
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : ℕ → α) (t : ℕ), (GenLimit.textPrefix stream t).length = t

docstring: Earlier ordered histories are list prefixes of later histories.
name: GenLimit.textPrefix_prefix
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : ℕ → α) {s t : ℕ}, s ≤ t → GenLimit.textPrefix stream s <+: GenLimit.textPrefix stream t

name: GenLimit.textPrefix_succ
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : ℕ → α) (t : ℕ),
  GenLimit.textPrefix stream (t + 1) = GenLimit.textPrefix stream t ++ [stream t]

docstring:
Forgetting order and repetitions from an ordered prefix gives the finite
sample used by the KM and DenseGeneration developments.
name: GenLimit.textPrefix_toFinset
type: ∀ (stream : ℕ → ℕ) (t : ℕ), (GenLimit.textPrefix stream t).toFinset = GenLimit.sample stream t

name: GenLimit.textPrefix_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (stream : ℕ → α), GenLimit.textPrefix stream 0 = []

name: GenLimit.value_mem_sample
type: ∀ {stream : ℕ → ℕ} {s t : ℕ}, s < t → stream s ∈ GenLimit.sample stream t
